entries.zh: 虽然过去的重担压在他的肩上，斯克兰德从未停止展望未来，而是带着热情和好奇心探索未知的世界。他庄重地宣誓履行自己的承诺。
entries.en: Although the past weighs on his shoulders, Skrand never loses sight of the future, approaching the unknown with passion and determination. With a solemn vow of service, he undertakes his duty.

entries.zh: 超出领袖上限产生对经验获取的乘算惩罚：$MULT$
entries.en: Multiplicative Experience Gain penalty from exceeding Leader Cap: $MULT$

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的轨道轰炸激起了内阁对面临可能要投降的场景时我们该如何应对的讨论。
entries.en: The Orbital Bombardment of §H[From.GetName]§! has sparked our Council to discuss how we should respond in the hypothetical scenario of a surrender.

entries.zh: 由于近期与智慧物种的接触，提升我们外星语言学能力非常重要。
entries.en: Given recent encounters with intelligent races, it is essential that we improve our xeno-linguistic capabilities.

entries.zh: 给与少量$r_influence$\n可以出现§H著名领袖§!。
entries.en: Grants a small amount of $r_influence$\nAllows §HRenowned Leaders§! to appear.

entries.zh: 我们已经毫无疑问地证明了星系处处充满生命。除了占主导地位的物种和国家，还有许多其他的星球。杰出个体可能会不时涌现，动摇着星系霸权的基础。\n\n如果我们能驾驭他们的雄心壮志，这些著名领袖可能会愿意加入我们的事业。
entries.en: We have proven beyond any doubt that the galaxy is filled with life. Apart from the dominant species and nations, there are many others who traverse the stars. From time to time, exceptional individuals may arise to shake the foundations of galactic power.\n\nIf we can harness their ambition, these renowned leaders may be willing to join our cause.

entries.zh: 我们已经毫无疑问地证明了星系处处充满生命。除了占主导地位的物种和国家，还有许多其他的星球。杰出个体可能会不时涌现，动摇着星系霸权的基础。\n\n尽管这些外星人的处事方式相当怪异甚至令人厌恶，但只要驾驭得了这些§H著名领袖§!的天赋，就可能会有助于我们的事业。
entries.en: We have proven beyond any doubt that the galaxy is filled with life. Apart from the dominant species and nations, there are many others who traverse the stars. From time to time, exceptional individuals may arise to shake the foundations of galactic power.\n\nAlthough their alien ways may be strange or even repellent, harnessing the talents of such §Hrenowned leaders§! may prove a boon to our cause.

entries.zh: 他们可能终究是有用的……暂时如此。
entries.en: They might prove useful... for a time.

entries.zh: 从现在起，可能会有§H著名领袖§!联系我们。
entries.en: From now on, §HRenowned Leaders§! can contact us.

entries.zh: 语言学家、猎头和探索者，他们通力协作，在所有已知的星系内踏破铁鞋寻找才华卓著者。著名领袖可以在这里招募来为我们的事业服务。
entries.en: Linguists, headhunters, explorers: they work together to scour the known stars in search of talent. Here, leaders of renown can be recruited to serve our cause.

entries.zh: $t$$MOD_COUNTRY_EXTERNAL_LEADER_POOL_SIZE$：§G+1§!\n$t$领袖经验获得：§G+10%§!\n$t$提升§H著名领袖§!联络我们的概率。
entries.en: $t$$MOD_COUNTRY_EXTERNAL_LEADER_POOL_SIZE$: §G+1§!\n$t$Leader Experience Gain: §G+10%§!\n$t$Increase chance for §HRenowned Leader§! to contact us.

entries.zh: 转念一想，我们并不需要你。
entries.en: On second thought, we don't need you.

entries.zh: 这个小助手可以帮助整理和分析数据。它的人工智能是研究机器人和伴侣机器人的独特组合。
entries.en: This little assistant helps out with sorting data and analyzing it. Its AI is a unique mix of research and companion bots.

entries.zh: 一位经验丰富的海盗，还有[Root.GetHisHer]从星系各个角落招募来的千奇百怪的船员。
entries.en: A seasoned corsair and [Root.GetHisHer] diverse crew, recruited from every corner of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 一位游历过很多地方的探险家，对许多外国文化有深刻的了解。对贸易和利润的兴趣不亚于科学发现。
entries.en: A well-traveled explorer with a deep knowledge of many foreign cultures; as interested in trade and profit as scientific discoveries.

entries.zh: 一位经过战火淬炼的贵族，在压倒性的强敌面前失去了[Root.GetHisHer]的舰队和家族。
entries.en: A battle-hardened noble who lost [Root.GetHisHer] fleet and his House to an overwhelming enemy force.

entries.zh: 一位身经百战的犀利武士。[Root.GetHeSheCap]视战争如生命，视战场如家乡。
entries.en: A fierce warrior who has survived many battles. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has a passion for war and is most at home in combat.

entries.zh: 一位偏执而孤独的实业家。[Root.GetHeSheCap]将[Root.GetHisHer]大部分时间都花费在[Root.GetHisHer]的工厂和铸造厂寻找效率。
entries.en: A paranoid and lonely industrialist. [Root.GetHeSheCap] spends most of [Root.GetHisHer] time searching for efficiencies in [Root.GetHisHer] many factories and foundries.

entries.zh: 一个已经消亡文明的战术机器人。它痴迷于秩序和结构，试图创造完美的社会。
entries.en: A tactical robot from a long-extinct civilization. Obsessed with order and structure, it seeks to design the perfect society.

entries.zh: 超然均衡教团的坚忍斗士。通过义体和生物科技进行升级，[Root.GetFirstName]誓要踏碎星系所有的暴政。
entries.en: A stoic warrior of the Numinous Equilibrium. Upgraded with cybernetics and biotechnology, [Root.GetFirstName] has vowed to rid the galaxy of tyrants.

entries.zh: 一位充满创造力和幽默感的科学家，还有一位友好的小机器人助手，“戈尔基”。[Root.GetHeSheCap]想要分享[Root.GetHisHer]的知识，来改善[Root.GetHisHer]身边人们的生活。
entries.en: A creative and playful scientist. Assisted by Gorky, a small friendly robot, [Root.GetHeSheCap] seeks to share [Root.GetHisHer] knowledge to improve the lives of those around [Root.GetHisHer].

entries.zh: 一位以合成人之身实现不朽的舰队司令。[Root.GetHisHerCap]的思维直接链接着[Root.GetHisHer]麾下的舰船。
entries.en: An admiral who found immortality in a synthetic form. [Root.GetHisHerCap] mind is now directly connected to the ships under [Root.GetHisHer] command.

entries.zh: 一位离开了自己的城邦的打捞者，[Root.GetFirstName]是一位无与伦比的机械师，几乎任何故障在[Root.GetHisHer]的手里都能迎刃而解。
entries.en: A salvager who has left [Root.GetHisHer] enclave, [Root.GetFirstName] is a peerless mechanic who can fix just about anything.

entries.zh: 一位退休法官，誓要继续为正义而战。
entries.en: A retired judge who has vowed to continue their fight for justice.

entries.zh: 一位成长于庭荠磁舵星姐妹会的魅力非凡的外交官。[Root.GetHeShe]为和平而战，通过[Root.GetHisHer]的计谋和谈判来实现目标。
entries.en: A charismatic diplomat raised in the Alyssum Magnetar Sisterhood. Fighting for peace, [Root.GetHeShe] wages [Root.GetHisHer] war through guile and negotiation.

entries.zh: 一位网络遍及星系的人脉广泛的信息掮客。
entries.en: A well-connected information broker whose networks span the breadth of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 一位贪婪的监工，在掌权的人面前卑躬屈膝，剥削和羞辱地位低贱者。[Root.GetHisHerCap]的聪明和残忍产生了非凡的结果。
entries.en: A greedy overseer who grovels before those who hold power, exploiting and humiliating those who do not. [Root.GetHisHerCap] intelligence and cruelty produce exceptional results.

entries.zh: 一个流浪的神秘主义者，[Root.GetHimHer]的智慧触动着周围的人。
entries.en: A wandering mystic whose wisdom touches all those around [Root.GetHimHer].

entries.zh: 一位从失落文明中搜集知识的档案管理员。[Root.GetHeSheCap]在死寂的星球上挖掘古老的奇迹，在星际间漂流的废弃船只中寻找遗物。
entries.en: An archivist who seeks to gather knowledge from dead civilizations. [Root.GetHeSheCap] digs up ancient wonders on dead worlds, and looks for relics in abandoned ships that drift through the void between stars.

entries.zh: 一位冷酷无情的佣兵战士，在战场上追寻着荣耀和名声。
entries.en: Ruthless mercenary warrior seeking glory and fame on the battlefield.

entries.zh:
§H面部识别扫描确认该个体为李萨拓·辛格，是一位通缉海盗。他狡黠地笑着，礼貌地点了点头。§!

你好，我是李萨拓船长。我是想来谈合作的。

我指挥着三艘船和一群被遗弃的乌合之众。到目前为止，我们是为……为自己效劳。换句话说，时代变了，我们已经准备好加入一个更大的事业。如果你们赦免我们所谓的罪行并在你们境内帮我们一个安全的避难所，我们将为你们效劳。

你怎么看？要签个合同吗？
entries.en:
§HFacial recognition scans identify the individual as Lysator Syng, a wanted pirate. Smiling slyly, he offers a polite nod.§!

Greetings, I am Captain Lysator. I come to you with an offer.

I command three ships and a rag-tag crew of outcasts. Until now, we have worked... independently. That said, times are changing, and we are ready to join a larger enterprise. If you grant us full pardons for our so-called crimes and a safe haven within your borders, we will work for you.

What do you say? Should we draw up a contract?

entries.zh: 我们要一个海盗有何用？
entries.en: What need do we have for a pirate?

entries.zh: 好吧，说到这个，我更愿意自称为一名私掠者。有些东西你在学校是学不到的。我的专长在于把握时机：什么时候出击，什么时候撤退，在敌人面前摆什么诱饵等等。哪里薄弱我们就袭击哪里，最后在别人意识到发生了什么之前就带着战利品逃走。
entries.en: Well, as to that, I prefer to think of myself as a privateer. Some things you just can't learn in an academy. My skills lie in finding opportunities: when to strike, when to retreat, what bait to dangle in front of a foe. We hit hard and where it hurts, and make off with the loot before anyone realizes what happened.

entries.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
entries.en: Why do you wish to join us?

entries.zh: 我的船员已经过腻了奔波的日子，想要寻找一处安全的港湾。你的帝国看起足够开放，能允许一群被驱逐的人加入其中。海盗生涯让我们也付出了很多代价，但我们还没打算安定下来，而你这样厉害的赞助人肯定能减轻我们的负担。
entries.en: My crew is tired of living a life on the run. We seek a safe harbor. Your empire seems open enough to allow a collection of outcasts into your ranks. Freebooting has cost us much; we're not exactly looking to settle down, but a patron of your calibre could take a certain load off.

entries.zh: 不凭什么，就凭我一介宵小之辈的话。如果这还不够，那就再见吧。我就是来提一笔买卖罢了，没指望别的什么。
entries.en: No reason, other than the word of a scoundrel. If that's not enough, fare thee well. I propose a deal, nothing more.

entries.zh: 逃跑的奴隶、赏金猎人、贪财的雇佣兵……还有一位怪厨子。我们来自星系的五湖四海，在自由和冒险的召唤下走到一起来了。在我去的日子里我们几乎成了一家人。只要听从命令并且不吃掉其他的船员，谁想来加入我都欢迎。我很荣幸能统领这一帮人才。
entries.en: Escaped slaves, bounty hunters, soldiers of fortune... Even the odd chef. From all corners of the galaxy they answered the call of liberty and adventure. Over the years we've grown into a family of sorts. I welcome anyone, as long as they follow my orders and don't try to eat any of the others. I consider it an honor to lead them.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_xenophile1$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。\n3艘海盗船被添加到我们的帝国中。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_xenophile1$§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.\n3 pirate ships are added to our empire.

entries.zh: §H女人带来了惊人的礼物：一块妥善保管的彗星碎片，一块缇扬奇骨雕，和一只装在罐子里的微小软体动物。§!\n\n你好，我叫诺娜，是科基尔家族的永恒受祝者。我以这些礼物来表达我的尊敬之情。我探索了许多星球，反复学习了许多课程。我愿在你的祝福下学习你们的文化，作为回报，我会向你分享数百个文明的智慧。
entries.en: §HThe woman bears fascinating gifts: a preserved shard from a comet, a Tiyanki bone carving, and a tiny molluscoid in a jar.§!\n\nGreetings, I am Nona, the Eternally Blessed of the House Colzyrion. I offer you these gifts as a token of esteem. I have explored many worlds, and relearned countless lessons. With your blessing, I would like to study your culture, and in return, share the wisdom of a hundred civilizations.
What can you do for us?

entries.zh: 我的特长在于外星学和外交。知识、财富和谈话本身就是我能给予的。毕竟人们除此之外还有什么它求吗？
entries.en: My expertise lies in both xenology and diplomacy. Knowledge, credits, and conversation are what I offer. What more could one ask for?
Why do you want to join us?

entries.zh: 我觉得你们的坦率和诚实很吸引人。你和我一样看到了合作中蕴含的可能性。能和这样开放的灵魂生活在一起是一种荣幸。
entries.en: You have an openness and honesty that I find appealing. Like me, you see the possibilities in collaboration. It will be a privilege to live among such open souls.

entries.zh: 你的文化特长是怎么来的呢？
entries.en: How did you come by your cultural expertise?

entries.zh: 理解一个外星文化的最好方式就是拥抱它。我初沐爱河是在一颗外星球上，他们的文化深深吸引了我。尽管我们已经不在一起了，但那段感情教会了我宽容和尊重的意义。从那以后，我尝试着在我所访问的地方尽可能多地学习，不再受各种偏见的拖累。
entries.en: The best way to understand a foreign culture is to embrace it. I discovered love for the first time on an alien world. I was fascinated by my partner and their culture, and even though we're no longer together, that relationship taught the meaning of tolerance and respect. Since then, I have tried to assimilate as much as I can in the places I visit, free from the burden of judgment.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_xenophile2$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。

§H男爵身材魁梧。他身上的一切都散发着严格的军旅气息：靴子一尘不染，制服熨得整整齐齐，他的眼神机警而富于计谋。但在严格的外表之外，还有别的东西：他的脸上写满了哀伤。§!

我可以作为一个舰队司令和战术家为您服务。

接受我的效忠，我就会粉碎那些可能伤害到你的人。
entries.en:
§HThe Baron is of imposing stature. Everything about him radiates rigid military discipline. His boots are spotless, his uniform neatly pressed, and his eyes are watchful and calculating. But beyond the strict facade, there is something else: his face is a map of grief.§!

I come to offer my services as an admiral and tactician.

Accept my pledge, and I will crush those who would do you harm.

entries.zh: 你说你是一位舰队司令，你的舰队呢？
entries.en: If you are an admiral, where is your fleet?

entries.zh:
羞愧之至，它不复存在了。

我们当时围绕着一颗红矮星进行着紧急维修，而我们的敌人在这时候暗算了我们。他们从四面八方包围而来。

我们以一敌十，在那血色般的恒星光芒中，我仿佛见到了我的舰队和船员们的末日。他们作为施舍饶了我一命。时至今日我还无法洗刷那场失败的耻辱。
entries.en:
To my shame, it is lost.

We were orbiting a red star, making vital repairs, when our enemies ambushed us. They came from all directions.

Outnumbered ten to one, I watched as my ships and their crews met their end around that hellish sun. As a parting 'gift', I was allowed to live. Even now, I carry the shame of that defeat.
Why do you wish to join us?

entries.zh: 你明白，和平是一件以战争作为价码的奢侈品。
entries.en: You understand that peace is a luxury bought by war.

entries.zh: 你不应该去侍奉你的亲族吗？
entries.en: Should you not serve your noble House?

entries.zh: 夏里登家族和我一同衰败了。我战败后，复仇的渴望蒙蔽了我的双眼。相信我，我的仇敌得到了应有下场。尽管我已经荣誉尽失，但我的技艺将常伴我身。为此我愿以生命起誓。
entries.en: House Jariden fell with me. After my defeat, I was consumed by a thirst for vengeance. Believe me, my enemies paid for what they did. My honor may have been taken, but not my skill in battle. On this I pledge my life.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_militarist1$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。

§H一队奴隶抬着一乘巨大的轿子，上面坐着一只可畏惧的爬行类。所有关于军阀的刻板印象都可以在她这里找到：大片骇人的伤疤，张扬跋扈的武器，作为杀戮战利品的骨架等等。§!

我叫基雅·祖蒙，这就是我开出的条件！

§H她从坐席上起身，随从徐徐跪服在她的身侧。§!

我将率领你的军队，击溃你的敌人。他们的星球将化为焦土，他们的财宝将为你所得。
entries.en:
§HA litter of enormous proportions is carried by a procession of slaves. Atop it sits a formidable reptilian. All the hallmarks of a warlord are there: extensive scarring, brazen weaponry, the skeletal remnants of past kills.§!

I am Gia'Zumon, and these are my terms!

§HAs she removes herself from the throne, the members of her entourage prostrate themselves before her.§!

I will lead your armies. I will break your enemies. Their worlds shall burn and their riches will be yours.

entries.zh: 等会儿。你怎么会想加入我们？
entries.en: Hold on. Why do you want to join us?

entries.zh:
我洗劫过无数的星球。这活儿倒是轻松，只是我已经腻了！那些个废物在官场、艺术和无聊的废话中浪费那么多时间。

§H她发出野性的嘶声，露出她锯齿状的牙齿。§!

但你的帝国很强大，你的敌人也是块美味的硬骨头！让我来嚼碎它们吧。我渴望像样的战斗！
entries.en:
I have sacked many worlds. And it was easy. And it was boring! The weak waste their time on bureaucracy, art, and senseless blather.

§HShe lets out a feral hiss and bares her jagged teeth.§!

Your empire is mighty and your foes are worthy! Let me destroy them. Give me a proper fight!

entries.zh:
呵！那可真是值得铭记的一天！两年前，我们入侵了一个遥远的星球。我们消灭了一切胆敢防抗的人，夺取了一切值钱的东西，把有价值的人收作奴隶。然后援军来了。

§H她摸着腰带上的一颗头骨，露出利齿狡黠地笑着。§!

那是一场血腥的屠杀，一曲残暴的赞歌。最后他们打败了我们，但我的战士们死得其所。我来，为的不是荣华富贵，我想要战斗。
entries.en:
Ha! Now, that was a day to remember! Two years ago, we invaded a remote world. We annihilated all who opposed us, seizing everything of value and taking the worthy as slaves. Then the reinforcements arrived.

§HShe touches one of the trophies hanging from her belt. She bares her teeth, grinning.§!

Such magnificent carnage. An ode to brutality. In the end they crushed us, but my warriors died well. I come to you now not for riches, or glory. I come seeking a challenge.

entries.zh: 战争是一种运动，是一种必需品，是一种工具。但是战斗……啊，它能说道的太多太多了。这是检测一个人极限最纯粹的方式。谁能不为这样的前途感到踌躇满志呢？
entries.en: War is a sport, a necessity, a tool. But the fight... Ah, now that reveals much. There is no purer way to test one's limits. Who would not be invigorated at the prospect?

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_militarist2$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H这位外星人被包裹在一个咯咯作响的生命维持装置中。浓稠的液体从管子和通风口流过，他的话语变成了一种潮湿的汩汩声。§!\n\n你们的工厂太差劲了吧。
entries.en: §HThe alien is encased in a gurgling life-support unit. Thick fluid sloshes through the tubes and vents, causing his speech to emerge in a wet gurgle.§!\n\nYour industrial plants are a disgrace.

entries.zh:
我的特长能够帮上你。让我告诉你什么叫效率。

§H外星人的触手湿哒哒地在头盔玻璃上扭动着。§!

强者壮大，弱者灭亡。星系从不缺少工人，我会给你带过来一些。他们要么工作，要么去死。利润则会滚滚而来。
entries.en:
You could benefit from my expertise. Let me show you the meaning of efficiency.

§HThe alien's tentacles twitch wetly against the helmet glass.§!

Reward the strong. Cull the weak. The galaxy has no shortage of workers. I will bring them to you. They will work, or they will die. And the profits will flow.

entries.zh:
你们足够纯粹，不和外人搞在一起。

§H随着可怕的喷溅声，液体充入了头盔。这个外星人挥舞着触手，表现出某种欣快感。§!

因为我们有一样的价值观。因为我也一样独善其身。
entries.en:
You do not mingle with outsiders.

§HWith a hideous sloshing sound, the helmet is flooded with liquid. Tentacles waving, the alien projects a certain euphoria.§!

Because I share your values. Because I keep myself apart.

entries.zh: 这就是你穿着隔离服的原因？
entries.en: Is that why you wear an environmental suit?

entries.zh:
正是。

§H一阵狂暴的吸气声。§!

在这里面，没有人能碰到我。在这里面我才感受得到洁净。
entries.en:
Just so.

§HA gurling intake of breath.§!

In here, nothing can touch me. In here, I am clean.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_xenophobe1$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H我们的传感器显示该机器人的外壳已经有数百年历史。它的语音缺乏音调，但话语却意外地洪亮。§!\n\n数据显示你的政府和附属国之间不协调。缺乏纪律。不合格的教化。建议操作：向系统中添加亚图里昂。删除不必要的功能。强调秩序。
entries.en: §HOur scans reveal that the outer shell of the robot is hundreds of years old. Its voice is monotone, but its words are oddly resonant.§!\n\nData indicates misalignment between your government and its subjects. Lack of discipline. Substandard indoctrination. Recommended action: addition of Aturion to the system. Eliminate unnecessary functions. Prioritize order.

entries.zh: 每个社会都是一个方程。请让亚图里昂来帮你解它。方程里不需要不确定项。
entries.en: Every society is an equation. Allow Aturion to solve yours. There is no need for uncertainty.
Why do you wish to join us?

entries.zh: 你们的文明接近理想状态。可以在最短的时间内达到完美的平衡。据亚图里昂计算，成功的可能性为91.1%。
entries.en: Your civilization approaches ideal conditions. Perfect balance can be attained in the shortest period of time. Aturion has calculated the likelihood of success at 91.1%.

entries.zh: 请说说那些……方程是怎么回事。
entries.en: Tell us more about these... equations.

entries.zh: §H从机器人胸口的一个端口投射出几十个全息图。它开始了单调乏味的解释，包括统计分析、经济学、心理分析、基因操纵……其中一个全息图是进度条。它表示演示将再持续127.8个标准日。§!
entries.en: §HFrom a port on the robot's chest, dozens of holograms are projected. It launches into a droning explanation that includes statistical analysis, economics, psychological profiling, genetic manipulation... One of the holograms is a progress bar. It indicates that the presentation will last another 127.8 standard days.§!

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_xenophobe2$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H这位武士装备着先进的武器和装甲。扫描显示其体内有高度的生化改造和义体升级。§!\n\n基恩将军听您吩咐。我是超然均衡教团的一位特使。我被派遣来帮助所有需要消除暴政的人。接纳我的誓言，我的武力将为你所用。
entries.en: §HThe warrior is armed with advanced weaponry and armor. Scans reveal extensive biological modifications and cybernetic enhancements.§!\n\nGeneral Jynn, at your service. I am an envoy of the Numinous Equilibrium. I have been sent to defend those in need and help bring about the end of tyranny. Accept my oath, and I shall put my arms at your service.

entries.zh: 我是一名为理想而战的士兵。我们教团致力于消除压迫、解放奴隶。我们愿为此抛头颅，洒热血。
entries.en: I am a soldier in service to an ideal. My order works to end oppression and free the enslaved. For this we spill our blood.
Why do you wish to join us?

entries.zh: 你们是一个崇尚平等的文明，所有的个体都能凭借自己的努力而成就伟大。这还不够吸引我吗？
entries.en: Yours is a civilization that celebrates equality, where any individual may rise to greatness on their own merit. Is this not reason enough?
Tell us more about your order.

entries.zh: 超然均衡教的创始人伊斯查顿宣扬平等的教义。自由是美丽而脆弱的。权力不应属于某一只手——它是一种必须共同承担的负担。我的教团成员发誓要维护这些价值观。
entries.en: The founder of the Numinous Equilibrium, Yschaton, preached a doctrine of equality. Freedom is as fragile as it is beautiful. Power was not meant for a single hand - it is a burden that must be shared. Members of my order vow to uphold these values.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_egalitarian1$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。

§H这位科学家全神贯注地看着手中的输入板，手指对着按键上下纷飞。她哼着欢快的旋律，似乎对工作心无旁骛。一个小型机器人同伴漂浮在她旁边的空中，它发出叽叽喳喳的声音，磕了一下她的肩膀。她倏然抬起头。§!

啊，对不起。你好！我是佐西拉。很抱歉打扰你们，那个，我之前的实验室相当于是，爆炸了。

§H小机器人又叽叽喳喳了起来。§!

啊所以，那个，我是说，我想要找一个地方能让我继续作曲。
entries.en:
§HThe scientist is focused on a tablet in her hand. As her fingers dance over the keys, she hums a cheerful melody. She seems lost in her work and oblivious to the world. A small robot companion floats in the air next to her; it chirps and bumps her shoulder. She looks up.§!

Oh, sorry. Hello, I'm Zosira. Sorry to bother you, but my last lab, well, it sort of blew up.

§HThe small robot chirps again.§!

Ah, yes, what I am trying to say is that I'm looking for a place to compose.

entries.zh:
是啊，宇宙就像音乐一样。环绕着的气态巨行星的振动，新生恒星的咆哮，盘旋原子的甜美歌谣……

§H她像是在指挥一支看不见的宇宙交响乐队一样挥舞着双手。§!

哒~哒~啦~噔~，加上合适的节奏，然后：当当！于是我们就创造了魔法！啊不是，科学。差不多一回事，真的。
entries.en:
The universe is music. The vibrations from the orbiting gas giants, the roar of a newborn star, the sweet song of swirling atoms...

§HShe gestures with her hands as if she were conducting an invisible cosmic orchestra.§!

Da da da dum, then add a fitting rhythm and: tadaa! We have created magic! Or, well, science. The same thing, really.
Why do you seek to join us?

entries.zh:
你们的想法看起来相当合意。我希望自己的发现能造福每个人，而不只是权贵子弟。这支宇宙的交响乐里可包含了奇迹和魔法！每个人都应该听到！

§H小机器人继续叽叽喳喳。§!

就是这样戈尔基！你说得一点儿也没错。
entries.en:
Your head seems to be in the right place. I want my discoveries to benefit everyone, not just the rich and powerful. The symphony of the universe, the wonders, the magic! Everyone deserves to hear it!

§HThe small robot chirps.§!

That's right Gorky! Very well said.

entries.zh:
欧，这是戈尔基！他是不是超可爱的？他是我自己造的，我做什么他都帮得上忙。

§H小机器人开心地叽叽喳喳。§!

好呀，好呀，我会告诉他们的。戈尔基为我安排会见、吃饭、饮水和睡眠的时间。你知道，我要是为一件事着迷的时候，就……咻——地会忘记时间。

§H小机器人继续叽叽喳喳。§!

哈哈对！就是就是！
entries.en:
Oh, this is Gorky! Isn't he adorable? I built him myself, and he helps me with everything.

§HThe robot chirps happily.§!

Okay, okay, I'll tell them. Gorky makes sure that I make my meetings, eat, drink and sleep. You know, when I get passionate about something, it's just... swoosh! I lose all track of time.

§HGorky chirps again.§!

Ha ha, yes! Exactly!
You say your lab blew up?

entries.zh:
哦，哎呀，怎么说呢？！你瞧，我的家乡在关于谁能当科学家这件事可是相当苛刻。所以，我从老旧工业区里搜刮破烂，悄悄组建了自己的实验室。我本以为离子化力场可以让易爆微粒稳定下来，但是……

§H小机器人一边叽叽喳喳一边发出滴滴声。§!

对吧？那些微粒的重低音可真是太劲爆了。所以我什么时候可以开始？
entries.en:
Oh, wow, where to start?! You see, my homeworld is very restrictive when it comes to who is allowed to be a scientist. So, I put together the lab in secret using whatever I could scavenge from the old industrial zones. Now, I thought the ionization field would keep the volatile motes stable, but...

§HThe small robot chirps and beeps.§!

Right? The bass from those motes was truly booming. So when do I start?

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_egalitarian2$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H在一架巨大的移动吊臂上悬着一副类人生物的头和躯干。这一定曾经是一个有机生物，但现在大部分已经由金属、电缆和塑料构成。毫无预兆下，那副躯干振动了一下活动了起来，两只合成眼发出光芒，发出嘎吱作响的嗓音。§!\n\n我是松达尔。我在寻找能效力的人。
entries.en: §HSuspended on a massive mobility crane is the head and torso of a humanoid. Once this must have been an organic being, but most of what remains is metal, wires and plastic. Without warning, the body jolts and comes to life, two synthetic eyes begin to glow, and a crackling voice emerges.§!\n\nI am Xondar. I seek a command.

entries.zh: 我曾经由血肉组成。像其他同类一样，我会受到疾病和年龄的侵蚀。血肉苦弱，因此我放弃了它。我把自己的意识被数字化并上载，成功地从囚禁我的躯体中刑满释放了。
entries.en: I was once flesh and blood. Like the rest of my people, I was vulnerable to age and disease. My flesh was weak, so I shed it. My consciousness was digitized and uploaded. I have broken free of the body that held me prisoner.
Why do you wish to join us?

entries.zh: 迷信、宗教信仰……都是毫无根据的谎言，最后不过是蛊惑人心化为屠戮的热血。那是无数战争和无尽苦难的根源。你和你的人看穿了这些无稽之谈。看得见，尝得到，摸得着的才叫真实。就像要达到完美必须抛弃肉体一样，幼稚的幻想也必须抛弃。
entries.en: Superstition, religion... Baseless lies, useful only to inflame the heart to murderous passion. The cause of countless wars and endless suffering. You and your people see through such nonsense. What is real can be seen, tasted, touched. Just as the flesh must be discarded to reach perfection, childish fantasies must be cast aside.

entries.zh: 你是想指挥一支舰队吗？
entries.en: You seek to command a fleet?

entries.zh: 你所见到的只是我的一小部分。虚空才是我的归宿，而我只是我舰队的一员。我的意识正扎根在舰船的系统中，传感器就是我的耳目，船壳就是我的肌肤。只要有我的执掌，你的舰队将达到无可比拟的强大。
entries.en: The form you see before you is but one part of me. The void is my home, and I am one with my ships. My consciousness is ingrained in their very systems; the sensors are my eyes and ears, the hull is my skin. With me at their head, I can direct your fleets to an unprecedented level of excellence.

entries.zh: 说说你怎么变成这样的？
还有什么可介绍的吗？我的身体生病了。我获得了一个保存意识的机会，然后我就抓住了它。许多其他人也常识这么做，但没有一个活到了现在。
entries.en: What is left to say? My body fell ill. I was offered a chance to save my mind, and I leapt at it. Many others tried the same. None survive today.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_materialist1$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H粗短结实的机械装置被挤压在一具外骨骼中。工具、零零散散的零件和油腻腻的手都能看出他是个修补匠，他的眼睛里闪烁着好奇和热情。§!\n\n早啊老板！我叫博林，诺嘉之子。很高兴认识你！
entries.en: §HThe short and sturdy mechanic is squeezed into an exoskeleton. Tools, scattered parts and greasy hands bear the telltale marks of a tinkerer, and his eyes glint with curiosity and enthusiasm.§!\n\nMornin' boss! I'm Borin, son of Noga. Pleased to make your acquaintance!

entries.zh: 那么你能为我们做什么？
entries.en: So, what can you do for us?

entries.zh:
我是一个有三十年经验的打捞者。这简历就已经够牛逼了吧。你要是有什么东西要建造或者修理，

§H他用大拇指戳了戳自己的胸口。§!

我都能搞定。我可不是吹牛，我真的什么东西都能修。而且不只有我一个，我还有一支可以拆解、切割、焊接、收集、修理和组装任何东西的订制机器团队。只要你想的话，给我一队人，我就能服务你整支海军。当然，人手越多越好哇！
entries.en:
Been a salvager for thirty years. I figure that'll do for a resume. You need things built? Something repaired?

§HHe points his thumb at his chest.§!

I can do it. Not to boast or anything, but I've fixed everything there is to be fixed. And not just me - I've got a team of custom bots to dismantle, cut, weld, gather, repair and reassemble whatever you need. Gimme a crew and I can service your whole navy if you want. The bigger the better as far as I'm concerned.

entries.zh: 我就是满世界跑，为自己谋个出路。你看起来是一个会重视劳动的老板、一位靠谱的领导。你能看清这个世界的本来面目，利用我们所拥有的东西来建设更美好的未来。
entries.en: I'm just trying to make my way in the galaxy. You seem like an employer that values hard work and a steady hand. Someone who sees the world for what it is, taking the things we have and using them to build a better future.

entries.zh: 那你为什么从之前的单位离职了？
entries.en: Why did you leave your previous job?

entries.zh: 你问真的吗？我腻了。从我记事起，我就梦想在虚空中遨游。我想逼一下自己看看能走多远。所以我就收拾好工具，然后就是现在这样咯。现在，还有别的问题吗？要不我们开建吧！
entries.en: Honestly? I got bored. Ever since I can remember I've dreamed of cruising the void. I want to push myself, see how far I can go. So I packed my tools and here I am. Now, unless you have more questions, what do you say we get building?

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_materialist2$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H这位外星人身着华丽和繁复的长袍。尽管年事已高，但他的双眼仍旧警觉，透出敏锐的智慧。§!\n\n向您致敬。我想作为一个和平卫士为您服务。
entries.en: §HThe alien is adorned in rich, intricate robes. Despite his obvious age, his eyes are alert and betray a keen intellect.§!\n\nSalutations. I come to offer my services as a keeper of peace.

entries.zh: 我是我族人中少数被选中的大法官之一。这是一个非常光荣的职位。我学习了许多星球的法律，通过长期的经验，我还学会了如何平衡正义的天平。
entries.en: I am one of the select few anointed as a Judge among my people. This is a position of great honor. I have memorized the laws of many worlds, and through long experience I have learned how to balance the scales of justice.

entries.zh: 你为什么想与我们共事？
entries.en: Why do you wish to work with us?

entries.zh: 我老了。我在办公室里忙碌了大半生。尽管对我这样的人来说为年轻人让位是再自然不过的，但我还不满足。犯罪是无国界的，我还有很多能做的事。这事众所周知，星系中有很多人来找过我，想让我为他们工作。但为那些用错权力的人工作有什么意义呢？我相信我们是一路人，能为你的人民服务是我的无上荣幸。
entries.en: I am old. I have served my time in office. Although it is the custom of my kind to give way to the young, I am not finished. Crime knows no border, and I still have much to offer. This is known, and many in the galaxy have approached me with offers of employment. But what sense is there in working for those who misuse their authority? I believe that our values align on this, and it would be my privilege to serve your people.

entries.zh: 是什么让你选择了法律？
entries.en: What led you to the law?

entries.zh:
宇宙就是一位无情的法官。

§H这位外星老人的咽喉深处发出了可怕暗哑的声音。§!

作为有情感的生物，我们有责任做得更好。只有理性才能诞生出公平。

§H他的目光停留在不远处。在那一瞬间他仿佛忘记了自己的存在。§!

法律的力量必须谨慎使用，不能让它成为不公正的根源。
entries.en:
The universe is a merciless judge.

§HFrom deep in the old alien's throat emerges an eerie clicking sound.§!

As sentient beings, it is up to us to do better. It is through reason alone that fairness is born.

§HHis gaze rests in the middle distance. For a brief moment, he seems to forget himself.§!

The power of the law must be used with caution, lest it become its own injustice.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_pacifist1$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H这位女士的服饰和珠宝让人对其生活的奢华窥见一斑。她轻轻一鞠躬后开口说道，§!\n\n我愿意作为一位总督和一位外交官而效劳。让我成为你的盟友，我能让你在星系的任何一个角落都找到强大的友邦。
entries.en: §HThe Sister's clothing and jewelry offer a glimpse into her opulent lifestyle. She bows before speaking.§!\n\nI offer my services as a governor, and as a diplomat. Make me your ally and I will ensure you have powerful friends, in every corner of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我在庭荠磁舵星姐妹会长大。和其她姐妹一样完成完成学业后，我被委任到了这个外派岗位上。多年来，我一直为别人出谋划策。对此斗胆一言，我还取得了一些小小的成功。
entries.en: I was raised in the Sisterhood of the Alyssum Magnetar. When my training was complete, like all my Sisters, I was assigned to an offworld position. For many years I provided counsel, and if I may be so bold as to claim it, I enjoyed some modest success.
Why do you wish to join us?

entries.zh: 我相信和平是唯一能给我们星系带来稳定未来的东西。外交的艺术如在刀尖上舞蹈。我相信你一定会重视这方面的。
entries.en: I believe that peace is the only thing that can create a stable future for our galaxy. The art of diplomacy is a subtle thing. I believe you can respect this.
Do you still serve the Sisterhood?

entries.zh: 我为一切生命效力。来吧，我们边喝杯热饮边继续这个话题。
entries.en: I serve all life. Now come, let's say we continue this conversation over a warm drink?

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_pacifist2$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H扫描显示，这个女人的斗篷里隐藏着许多令人震惊的武器。我们找不到任何关于她存在的官方记录，但面部识别算法显示她至少参与了三起备受关注的暗杀。§!\n\n请允许我省去那些繁文缛节。你是个聪明人，知道宇宙中危机四伏，其中的许多甚至目不可及。只要出个好价钱，我就能让你一窥究竟。
entries.en: §HScans show that the woman's cloak conceals a truly shocking array of weaponry. We cannot find any official record of her existence, yet facial-recognition algorithms place her in the vicinity of at least three high-profile assassinations.§!\n\nAllow me to dispense with the formalities. You are no fool. You understand that the universe is full of dangers, most of them invisible. For the right price, I can reveal them.

entries.zh: 我是谁这一点都不重要。我想你会更感兴趣我有什么能耐。我是一件利器，只要给我足够的时间，就没有任何人敢反抗你。毕竟，死人是不会背叛你的。
entries.en: Who I am is of no importance. Better ask what I can do for you. I am a useful tool. Give me time, and none will dare rebel. After all, there can't be a betrayal if the traitors are already dead.

entries.zh: 单打独斗确实有好处，缺点就是不太稳定。在什么都要亲力亲为一段时间后，谁都会感到疲惫。实话说，我已经分了太多的心了。您王座后的阴影正是我最佳的藏身之所。更何况，在这我还可以让我以不同的，更微妙的手段来做事。
entries.en: Working as an independent has its perks, but stability isn't one of them. After a while, one tires of playing all sides at once. To be honest, I was starting to attract too much attention. The shadow of your throne is as good a spot as any for me to lay low. Plus it lets me try my hand at a different, more subtle game.

entries.zh: 相信？你不可能也大可不必相信我。我只卖给出价最高的人。只要你出价够高，那就没必要担心。此外，要真有人要你相信他，这反倒才相当可疑，甚至可以说是危险。对这种人我会立即派一队人去监听他家，跟踪他，密切关注他遇到的每一个人。
entries.en: You can't and shouldn't. I sell to the highest bidder. Just make sure that's you and there's no need to worry. Besides, if someone says that you should trust them, I would say that such a person is suspicious. Perhaps even treacherous. I would immediately send a team to bug their home, tail them and keep tabs on whoever they meet.

entries.zh: 你的武装对一个间谍而言也太重型了点。
entries.en: For a spy, you come heavily armed.

entries.zh: 在我这一行，一点意外都能让人死无葬身之地。我更喜欢准备充分一点。
entries.en: In my line of work, surprises tend to be fatal. I like to be ready.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_authoritarian1$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H这位外星人的皮肤闪烁着粘稠的分泌物。他煞费苦心地深鞠了一躬。但当他一开口，声调却像孩子一样出奇地尖细。§!\n\n这位大人，欧！至高无上的统治者。我，看守人喀·拉，只是您卑微的仆人。您的每句话都是命令。让我管理一颗你的星球，我会给您带来荣耀和财富。啊，那么多的财富！
entries.en: §HThe alien's skin glistens with viscous secretions. He bows elaborately from the waist. When he speaks, his voice is surprisingly high pitched, almost childlike.§!\n\nMy lord, Your Honor, Oh! Supreme ruler - I, Q'la-Minder, am but your humble servant. Your word shall be my command. Let me take charge of one of your planets, and I will bring you glory and wealth. Oh, so much wealth!
What exactly can you do for us?

entries.zh:
我们都明白一些道理。比如平民是懒惰的。他们总是要求更多的权利，更高的工资，更多的自由……如果不加以控制，他们就会把本该属于您的东西塞进肚子里！但如果让我负责的话……

§H他慢慢地攥紧拳头。§!

给我一颗行星，我会把这些思想残渣从他们的脑子里榨出去。然后他们将对您感恩戴德，伟大的王。欧！他们真会如此！
entries.en:
We both know how things are. The commoner is lazy. Always demanding more rights, higher wages, more freedom... Left unchecked, they would stuff their bellies with what rightly belongs to you! But if I were placed in charge...

§HSlowly, he clenches a fist.§!

Just give me a planet, and I will squeeze these silly notions from their heads. They will show gratitude, Glorious One. Oh! They will indeed!
Why do you seek to join us?

entries.zh:
谁会放弃为这样伟大的您效劳的机会呢？

§H他期待地咯咯笑了起来。§!

有些人生为王者，其他人就应当臣服。这就是万物之理。您可以信任我。我会忠诚地为您效劳。
entries.en:
Who would not leap at the chance to serve such majesty?

§HHe giggles with anticipation.§!

Some are born to rule. The rest must be led. That is the order of things. You can trust me. I will serve you faithfully.

entries.zh: 哦，圣洁的王！这只我的真实感想！请让我继续说下去好吗？和您相比，我不过是一坨烂泥、一只在泥土里蠕动的幼虫！赞美您是我的荣幸和特权。仅仅是您的存在就使我满心欢喜。请允许我以无限的忠诚为您服务!
entries.en: Oh, most Exalted One! This is but a taste! Shall I go on? Compared to you, I am but slime. I am but a larva wriggling in the dirt! Praising you is my honor and my privilege. Your mere Presence floods me with joy. Let me serve you with boundless devotion!

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_authoritarian2$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H这位外星人一动不动。§!\n\n命运指引着我的每一步。我穿越了无边的黑暗来到你的面前。我是神谕者尤拉斯塔尔。
entries.en: §HThe alien is motionless.§!\n\nFate guides my steps. I have crossed the blind reaches to stand before you. I am Ulastar, the Oracle.

entries.zh: 你能说说我们的命运吗？
entries.en: What can you say about our destiny?

entries.zh: §H他仿佛用那双盲眼凝视着。§!\n\n在一条路上，白色的火焰在虚空中燃烧。另一条则覆满飞溅的余烬。你们将面对恐怖，那将是你们的毁灭。除非？命运之线织出最微弱的希望。厄运或许可以避免。
entries.en: §HHe stares with blind eyes.§!\n\nOn one path, a white flame burns against the void. Along the other lies a sputtering ember. You will face Terror, and it shall be your undoing. Unless? The threads of fate weave the thinnest hope. Doom may yet be averted.
Why do you seek to join us?

entries.zh: §H他从一个隐藏的袋子里扔出一团旋转的尘埃。当他说话时，就通过这样的方式做出宣告：§!\n\n我受到召唤而来。你们必会或必将遇见我。
entries.en: §HFrom a hidden pouch he flings a swirling cloud of dust. When he speaks, he does so as a proclamation:§!\n\nI came because I was called. You have sought me out. Or perhaps you will.
What exactly will you do for us?

entries.zh: §H从长袍的内袋中，$NAME_spiritualist1$翻出了一套雕刻的骨头。将它们抛到地上后，他似乎在通过某种超越视觉的感官在观察这些骨头的摆放。§!\n\n我会与信徒分享我之所见。我会在你的民族之船即将坠入风暴时将它扶正。
entries.en: §HFrom the folds of his robes $NAME_spiritualist1$ produces a set of carved bones. Scattering them across the floor, he appears to study the pattern with senses beyond sight.§!\n\nI will share my visions with the faithful. I will right the ship of your nation as it prepares to plunge into the storm.
How did you come by your gifts?

entries.zh: 许多年前，我在一个行星矿坑里辛苦工作。虽然我的肉眼能看见，但我的心之眼却被物质世界蒙蔽了。后来，我觉醒的那一天到来了。\n\n他们说这是意外，但我知道这是天意。突然的爆炸声炸裂了我的视觉神经。在随后的黑暗中，我看到了时间之河。直到今天，它还在我眼前汩汩流淌。
entries.en: Many years ago, I toiled in the pits of a planetary mine. Though my physical body could see, my soul was blinded by the material world. Then came the day of my awakening.\n\nThey called it an accident, but I know it was providence; a sudden explosion fried my optical nerves. In the darkness that followed, I perceived the river of time. To this day, it flows before my eyes.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_spiritualist1$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
§H这位男子形如枯骨，饱经风霜：他精美的服饰几乎褪色殆尽，他的皮肤如羊皮纸般干燥粗糙，他的嗓音近乎低语。§!\n\n吾名为纳苏兹·德墨忒尔。吾身为纤尘与迷思所化。感谢您接纳我。
entries.en: §HThe man is thin to the point of starvation. There is a sense of decrepitude about him: his fine clothes are faded, his skin as dry as parchment, and his voice rises barely above a whisper.§!\n\nMy name is Nasuz Demetor. I am a collector of dust and myth. Thank you for receiving me.

entries.zh: 纤尘与迷思是什么东西？
§H他微笑了起来，皮肤为之绷紧。§!\n\n星系非常古老。在你们之前，已有无数的文明兴起又衰败。纤尘是他们的遗产，迷思是我们的传承。我尝试发掘过去的真相，让人可以铭记，可以学习。
entries.en: §HHis smile strains the surface of his skin.§!\n\nThis galaxy is old. Long before yours came to be, countless other civilizations rose and fell. Dust is their legacy, and myth our inheritance. I seek to uncover the truth of the past, that it may be preserved. That it may be learned from.
And this is why you've come?

entries.zh: 这不止是为了我自己的好处，我保证。历史之赋予远超我们的想象，我将与你分享。
entries.en: It is not only for my own benefit, I assure you. No, the riches of the past are beyond counting. I would share them with you.

entries.zh: 你通过考古得到了什么呢？
entries.en: What have you gained from your excavations?

entries.zh: 文物、智慧、景观……但不止于此。过往的一切皆有回声。是不是听起来有点自相矛盾？明明我们在与遗忘抗争，却往往忘记去倾听。
entries.en: Artifacts, wisdom, splendor... But not only this. All things have their echo in the past. Paradoxical is it not? How in our fight against oblivion we often forget to listen.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_spiritualist2$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。

§Y[Root.GetName]§!知道很多关于可怕的海盗之王兹泰格·迈尔的故事。几个世纪前，他一路劫掠星系，攫取财富，稀有资源和价值连城的古代文物。现在，多亏了一套古老的星图，[Root.GetFirstName]相信[Root.GetHeShe]已经发现了哲泰格-迈尔藏匿他大量战利品的地方。[Root.GetFirstName]拒绝详细说明究竟是如何获得这些海图的，但可以相信它们的真实性，并希望我们派一艘工程船去挖掘宝藏。如果那儿还有宝藏的话。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! knows many stories about the dreaded Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr. Centuries ago, he pillaged his way across the galaxy, seizing riches, rare resources and ancient artifacts of untold value. Now, thanks to a set of old star charts [Root.GetFirstName] believes [Root.GetHeShe] has discovered where Zteg-Mayr hid his bountiful booty. [Root.GetFirstName] refused to elaborate on how he acquired the charts, but believes them to be real, and wants us to send a construction ship to excavate the treasure. If there's anything left.
The pirate treasure of Zteg-Mayr discovered by [event_target:renowned_xenophile1.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们找到了大海盗兹泰格·迈尔藏匿他的宝藏的地下掩体。这些从许多星球偷来的宝物，现在将造福于我们的民族。
entries.en: The underground vault containing the treasure of Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr has been breached. This treasure trove of artifacts, stolen from a number of different worlds, will now benefit our nation.

entries.zh: 我们欢迎§Y[Root.GetName]§!的传言已经传遍了星系。现在各种被放逐者、恶棍，还有海盗都把我们的帝国看作一个向所有人开放的地方，在这里所以人都可以有新的开始。[Root.GetFirstName]正在利用这一点，重新树立名望，并邀请他以前的熟人加入我们。许多人响应号召，来寻找更好的新生活。
entries.en: Word of the welcome we extended to §Y[Root.GetName]§! has spread across the galaxy. Outcasts, scoundrels, and pirates of all stripes now view our nation as open to all, a place where anyone can start over. [Root.GetFirstName] is playing on this and enjoying his newfound fame, and has invited his former acquaintances to join us. Many have answered the call, looking for a new, better life.

entries.zh: 这些曾经被放逐的人面对重启人生的机会展现出极大的感激，很快就接受了我们的方式。
entries.en: Showing great appreciation for the opportunity of a fresh start, these former outcasts have quickly taken to our ways.

entries.zh: 这些曾经被放逐的人在我们的社会中很难找到一席之地，感觉到自己并不被欢迎，就倾向于向社会表达出他们的不满。
entries.en: Being slow to find their place in our society, these former outcasts feel unwelcome and tend to express their unrest.

entries.zh: 这些曾经被放逐的人尝试滥用我们的信任欺骗了我们的善良。
entries.en: Seeking to exploit our trust, these former outcasts have preyed on our kindness.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!听说了一支失踪的船队携带了大量财宝的传言。据说有一位外星使者和他的随从被派去给某个军阀带去贡品。在最近的一次任务中，[Root.GetHeShe]准确地定位了船队最后的位置。我们只需要派一艘船去取回它。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has heard rumors about the vast riches carried by a lost convoy. It seems that an alien emissary and his retinue were sent to bring tribute to a certain warlord. During [Root.GetHisHer] latest assignment [Root.GetHeShe] was able to pinpoint the convoy's last location. We only need to send a ship to retrieve it.

entries.zh: 别介意我们的所作所为。
[event_target:renowned_xenophile2.GetName]发现的一支古老的船队。传言称其中有着大量财宝。
entries.en: An ancient convoy found by [event_target:renowned_xenophile2.GetName]. It is rumored to contain vast riches.

entries.zh: 对失踪船队的打捞工作已经完成。所有位于失事地点的资源都已经得到回收。
entries.en: The salvage operation of the lost convoy has concluded. All of the resources located at the crash site have been recovered.

entries.zh: 一位§Y[Root.GetName]§!曾经的伙伴，布洛葛行政官§Y$NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$§!希望加入我们的帝国。这位行政官遇上了麻烦，正在寻找重新开始的机会。[Root.GetFirstName]声称这位$NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$对管理矿产星球的经验相当丰富，而那位和善的行政官也带来了一箱珍贵的矿物作为见面礼。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]'s§! ex-partner, the Blorg official §Y$NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$§!, wishes to join our empire. The official has fallen on hard times and is looking for a fresh start. [Root.GetFirstName] claims $NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$ has vast experience in the management of mining worlds, and that the affable official has brought a cache of precious minerals as a token of goodwill.

entries.zh: 他应该还是能有点用的。
entries.en: We can probably find some use for him.

entries.zh: 一个叫§Y$NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$§!的布洛葛作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
entries.en: The Blorg §Y$NONA_BLORG_EX_HUSBAND_NAME$§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

entries.zh: 一位靠自我奋斗塑造而成的勤奋的布洛葛。
entries.en: A hardworking Blorg, shaped by countless personal struggles.

entries.zh: 终于，§Y[Root.GetName]§!终于从[Root.GetHeShe]家族衰败的情绪低落中恢复出来。在摆脱了负罪和悲痛的枷锁之后，在服务我们的人民中终于找到了[Root.GetHisHer]新的人生意义。
entries.en: At long last, §Y[Root.GetName]§! has recovered from the emotional shock of the fall of [Root.GetHisHer] once-proud noble House. Unburdened by the guilt and melancholy, [Root.GetHeShe] has found a new purpose in the service of our people.

entries.zh: 在一场激情似火的演讲中，§Y[Root.GetName]§!宣称帝国必须将重心放在扩张上。[Root.GetHeSheCap]提交了两个关于给舰队调配更多资源以完成目标的计划。这两者确实对我们的舰队都很有价值，从长远看来也能让我们都收益。然而同时事实两个计划是不可能的。
entries.en: In a fiery speech, §Y[Root.GetName]§! declared that the nation's focus must be on expansion. [Root.GetHeSheCap] submitted two plans on how the fleet could use additional resources to further such a goal. Both options are valid and could benefit us greatly in the long run. However, implementing both plans at once is impossible

entries.zh: 舰队强大的是真的强大。
entries.en: A strong fleet will show them our might.

entries.zh: 后勤补给才是胜利的保障。
entries.en: Superior logistics will lead us to victory.

entries.zh: 赢得战斗需要策略，但自身的强大则是成功的源泉。当需要使用强力手段时，当然是越强力越好。
entries.en: Battles are won with strategy, but strength remains the foundation of success. When applying force, it is best to do so resolutely.

entries.zh: 提升效率的作用绝对不容小视：优化船坞的产出，我们的扩张将会因此变得更加迅捷。
entries.en: Efficiency should not be underestimated: By optimizing the output of our shipyards, our expansion will be that much swifter.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!赢得过许多战争。[Root.GetHeSheCap]曾经同另一位伟大的勇士，$GIA_ZUMON_GREAT_WARRIOR_NAME$，一起并肩作战。此人正在寻求新的可以侍奉的主人。他是一位果敢的舰队司令，[Root.GetFirstName]对其大加褒奖。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has won many battles. [Root.GetHeSheCap] once fought alongside another great warrior, $GIA_ZUMON_GREAT_WARRIOR_NAME$, who is looking for a new master to serve. He is a ruthless admiral, and [Root.GetFirstName] speaks highly of him.
Glory awaits him if he joins us.

entries.zh: 一位叫§Y$GIA_ZUMON_GREAT_WARRIOR_NAME$§!的奇恩舰队司令作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
entries.en: The Tzynn Admiral §Y$GIA_ZUMON_GREAT_WARRIOR_NAME$§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

entries.zh: 关于战争他能教授我们一些什么？
entries.en: What can he teach us about war?

entries.zh: 一位身经百战的果敢的舰队司令。人们说[Root.GetHeSheCap]铁石心肠，只在乎杀戮和毁灭。
entries.en: A ruthless admiral who has fought in many wars. [Root.GetHeSheCap] is said to be heartless, caring only for slaughter and destruction.

entries.zh: 我们的舰队在那位伟大的战士，$GIA_ZUMON_GREAT_WARRIOR_NAME$知识的沐浴下变得更加强大了。
entries.en: Our fleets have benefited from the knowledge of the great warrior, $GIA_ZUMON_GREAT_WARRIOR_NAME$.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!坐立不安，渴望战斗。[Root.GetHeSheCap]受够了那些荼毒[coliseum_planet.GetName]的懦夫。[Root.GetHeSheCap]提议建造一座大型竞技场，让荣誉猎手和罪犯身处同一地方。这样一个计划能够为我们的战士提供宝贵的实训机会。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! is restless and craves a fight. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has had enough of the weaklings that plague [coliseum_planet.GetName]. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has proposed an arena where glory-hunters may be pitted against criminals. Such a plan is sure to provide our warriors with valuable training.
This is not the way to do it.

entries.zh: 尽管我们的战士很珍惜这次发泄压力的机会，但高昂的嗜血在民众中滋生了焦虑。
entries.en: Though our warriors appreciate the chance to blow off steam, the kindled bloodthirst has led to some anxiety among the populace.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!希望能自动化[planet_governed.GetName]上的物流方案。提出的计划称会将工厂、精炼厂和处理设施通过一个复杂的管道和传送带网络连接起来。该计划在理论上看起来不错，但对生活在附近的人口而言存在风险。工业泄漏、辐射和高频振动之类危险是真实存在的。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! wishes to automate the shipping methods on [planet_governed.GetName]. The proposed plan would link the factories, refineries, and processing facilities together through a complex network of pipelines and conveyor belts. Although the project looks good in theory, there are risks for the population living nearby; between industrial spillages, radiation concerns and high-frequency vibration, the danger is real.
No, we must protect the people.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_xenophobe1$§!设计的复杂货运管道，超级高效，但要付出居民的健康为代价。
entries.en: Complex shipping pipelines of §Y$NAME_xenophobe1$'s§! making; highly efficient, but at the cost of the population's health.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!提交了一项研究计划，旨在评估未来的工业发展。该研究将会惠及经济，并促进[Root.GetHisHer]的个人发展。[Root.GetHeSheCap]准备了一系列非常具有意义、但可能会导致受试目标死亡的实验。[Root.GetHeSheCap]向我们保证这些实验只是需要一些小小的牺牲来成就上善之道。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has presented research plans to evaluate future industrial developments. This could benefit the economy as well as [Root.GetHisHer] personal projects. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has prepared a number of experiments that look very promising but would likely kill most of the test subjects. [Root.GetHeSheCap] assures us that a small sacrifice is necessary for the greater good.
No, this is cruel and unethical.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_xenophobe1$§!推进工业进一步发展的工作并不是毫无代价的；那些在他的试验中幸存下来的人迅速证实了这一说法。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_xenophobe1$'s§! work to further industrial development is not risk free; a claim eagerly substantiated by those who survive his tests.

entries.zh: 产业工人为从§Y$NAME_xenophobe1$§!的残忍实验中拯救出来而欢欣鼓舞。
entries.en: Industry workers rejoice at being saved from §Y$NAME_xenophobe1$'s§! unsparing tests.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!提出了一项人口优化计划，以一些特定的个人自由为代价，将生产力提升至少6.98%。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has devised a population optimization plan that, at the expense of certain personal freedoms, would increase production by at least 6.98%.

entries.zh: 为了集体的利益，人民本应准备好献出生命和肢体。与之相比，这些小小的改变根本不值一提。
entries.en: For the good of the whole, our people should be prepared to give both life and limb. By comparison, these small changes are a kindness.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!开发了一项复杂的改过计划，把社会上那些问题分子改造成勤勉的公民。风险评估估计，17.3%的罪犯将不可能改过自新，这应该被认为是‘可接受的损失’。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has developed a complex rehabilitation program to reform the more troublesome elements in our society into diligent citizens. Risk assessment estimates that 17.3% of the criminal population will be impossible to rehabilitate and should be considered 'acceptable losses.'
Can't we make it less risky?

entries.zh: 让一个人放弃自己的犯罪倾向需要付出努力，通常都需要外部的介入。我们将会适当地提供这种介入手段。
entries.en: Forgoing one's criminal inclinations takes work, and usually requires an external push. That push will be duly provided.

entries.zh: 这些项目依靠的是教育和改进，而不是强制的预防措施，这有助于让民众更幸福。
entries.en: Relying on pedagogy and improvements rather than forceful, preventative measures, these programs are conducive to a happier populace.

entries.zh: 超然均衡的特使§Y[Root.GetName]§!雇了一位学徒。这位有前途的年轻战士想要宣誓效忠于我们。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§!, the Numinous Equilibrium's envoy, has taken on an apprentice. The promising young warrior wishes to swear an oath of allegiance to us.
They are welcome to join us.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_egalitarian1$§!的实习指挥官作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_egalitarian1$'s§! apprentice Commander joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

entries.zh: 我们不需要将军，需要军官。
自幼受[event_target:renowned_egalitarian1.GetName]战士的训练，会帮助需要帮助的人。
entries.en: Trained since childhood by the warrior [event_target:renowned_egalitarian1.GetName] to help those who are helpless.

entries.zh: 对所有指挥官而言，可靠和忠诚的下属都是至关重要的。
entries.en: Reliable and loyal subordinates are vital for any commander.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!向[Root.GetHisHer]的教团“超然均衡”请求支援，来帮助我们帝国继续对抗暴政和压迫者。为我们运送宝贵合金的货船已经从他们的秘密总部抵达。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has requested support from [Root.GetHisHer] order, the Numinous Equilibrium, to aid our empire in the ongoing struggle against tyranny and oppressors. Freighter ships carrying valuable alloys to sustain us have arrived from their secret headquarters.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!和[Root.GetHisHer]的机器人伙伴戈尔基花费大部分业余时间进行私人实验。其中一些现在得到了有趣的结果，[Root.GetHeShe]与我们帝国的科学家们分享了[Root.GetHisHer]的发现。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! and [Root.GetHisHer] robot companion Gorky have spent much of their spare time conducting private experiments. Some of them have now yielded interesting results, and [Root.GetHeShe] has shared [Root.GetHisHer] findings with our empire's scientists.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!收养了一只外星生物来陪伴[Root.GetHisHer]的机器人助手戈尔基。它是一只五彩斑斓的未开智软体动物，表现出了不俗的智力，能对口哨指令作出反应。收养这只生物似乎改变了[Root.GetHisHer]的性格，[Root.GetHimHer]变得更加有责任心，更加安定了。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has adopted an alien creature to accompany [Root.GetHisHer] robot assistant Gorky. It's a colorful mollusk who, though pre-sapient, exhibits an impressive intellect and responds to whistled commands. Taking responsibility for the creature appears to have altered [Root.GetHisHer] personality, making [Root.GetHimHer] far more responsible and balanced.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!声称已经在多方面“改进”了[Root.GetHisHer]的身体。在没有获得允许的情况下，[Root.GetHeShe]为了庆祝[Root.GetHisHer]自己达到了完美的阶段而向整支舰队发送信息，并就此发表了一份宣言称，文明的出路唯有合成飞升：所有有机生命都脆弱不堪，无法逃离死亡。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! claims to have 'improved' [Root.GetHisHer] physical form in a number of ways. Without permission, [Root.GetHeShe] has sent messages across the fleet celebrating [Root.GetHisHer] perfected state and has released a manifesto claiming that the only viable future for a civilization is synthetic ascension: all organic life is frail and doomed to die.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!从国境内所有的舰船传感器上收集数据。使用算法计算重力扭曲后，[Root.GetFirstName]发现了我们的宇域中有一个天体的表面下隐藏着什么东西。如果数据准确无误，那么那颗荒芜的岩石下应该满是稀有合金。[Root.GetFirstName]将此视为一个拓展并升级舰队的好机会，提议派遣一艘工程船去挖取那些合金。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has collected sensor data from all ships within the our borders. Using algorithms that calculate gravimetric distortions [Root.GetFirstName] has discovered something hidden beneath the surface of one of the galactic objects in our space. If the data is correct, the barren rock should be filled with rare alloys. [Root.GetFirstName] sees this as an opportunity to expand and upgrade the fleet, and proposes dispatching a construction ship to extract the alloys.

entries.zh: 舰队司令[event_target:renowned_materialist1.GetName]在这颗荒芜星球里发现的高价值合金。
entries.en: Valuable alloys have been discovered by Admiral [event_target:renowned_materialist1.GetName] on this barren world.

entries.zh: 在炸开几公里深的岩石后，发现了一批珍贵的合金。我们已经开始了检索操作。
entries.en: A trove of precious alloys has been uncovered after several kilometers of rock were blasted away. We have started retrieval operations.
I Was Born in the Year of ...

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!在[Root.GetHisHer]的房间里闭门数月撰写自传，其中不仅有[Root.GetHisHer]自己的毕生经历，还有[Root.GetHeShe]所了解的工程学研究、建设和稀有材料的知识。只要拜读[Root.GetHisHer]的大作，我们的科学家就一定能有所发现。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has spent months in [Root.GetHisHer] cabin writing a self-biography that includes not only [Root.GetHisHer] life story and travels, but also everything [Root.GetHeShe] knows about engineering research, construction, and rare materials. When reviewing his work, our scientists made some interesting discoveries.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!建造了一个机器伙伴，叫做$BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$。这台机器人具有高级学习能力，并且拥有人格矩阵。它帮助[Root.GetName]进行[Root.GetHisHer]的研究和维修工作。然而，与它的创造者一样，$BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$也是好奇心满满，渴望着离开家去冒险。[Root.GetName]问我们，$BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$能不能在我们社会中拥有自主的一席之地？
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! built a robot companion named $BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$. The robot is capable of advanced learning, and has a personality matrix. It is assisting [Root.GetName] with [Root.GetHisHer] research and repair jobs. However, like its creator, $BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$ is curious and longs to leave home to embark on its own adventures. [Root.GetName] wonders if $BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$ could play an autonomous role within our society.
She has a knack for ships, right?

entries.zh: 一位叫§Y$BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$§!的机器人舰队司令作为一名§H领袖§!加入了我们的帝国。
entries.en: The robot Admiral §Y$BORIN_ROBOT_COMPANION_NAME$§! joins our empire as a §HLeader§!.

entries.zh: 我们可以把它安排进一些办公室里……
entries.en: We can use her in some office...

entries.zh: 一个人工智能助理，由打捞者[event_target:renowned_materialist2.GetName]建造和训练。
entries.en: An AI assistant, built and trained by the salvager [event_target:renowned_materialist2.GetName].

entries.zh: 打捞者§Y$NAME_materialist2$§!的机器人伙伴，现在任职于办公室中，可以积极利用她的高级学习能力，精简帝国相关流程。
entries.en: Salvager §Y$NAME_materialist2$'s§! robot companion has taken to office work, helping to refine our procedures by putting her self-learning capabilities to good use.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!长期在调查一处境内隐秘发展的犯罪网络。[Root.GetHeSheCap]将许多犯罪头目和海盗与腐败政客和军官勾结的证据整理到了一起。[Root.GetName]采用了新系统来加快此类案件的司法程序，目的是在罪犯有机会离开我们的司法管辖区之前抓住他们。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has been investigating a criminal network that has been growing quietly within our borders. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has put together evidence that connects various crime lords and pirates with corrupt politicians and military officers. [Root.GetName] has implemented new systems to expedite judicial proceedings in cases like this, with the intention of catching all criminals before they have a chance to leave our jurisdiction.

entries.zh: 一系列用于对抗大规模犯罪阴谋的新法规
entries.en: A series of new legislation to fight large scale criminal conspiracies.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!花费了[Root.GetHisHer]的大半生学习犯罪的本源和暴力侵犯的动机。[Root.GetHeSheCap]向专家寻求建议，研究其他现存和已故帝国的文化，并使用先进算法来设想一个乌托邦社会可能的样子。[Root.GetHisHerCap]的毕生心血凝聚成了一篇宏大的社会学论文，将会对未来的几代人起到指导作用。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has spent [Root.GetHisHer] life studying the nature of crime and the motivation of violent offenders. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has sought advice from experts, studied the cultures of other empires, both living and dead, and used advanced algorithms to envision what a utopian society might look like. [Root.GetHisHerCap] life's work has culminated in a vast sociological essay that will serve as a guide for future generations.
A great benefit to us all.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!因举办奢华宴会而享有盛誉。这些宴会以庭荠磁舵星成员的精彩表演、奇异的食物和饮料以及哲学和伦理讨论而闻名。在这里，人们建立有意，促成交易，解开心结。[Root.GetHisHerCap]将这么多千差万别的人凝聚起来的能力是我们繁荣发展的坚实基础。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has garnered a wide reputation for hosting lavish feasts. The gatherings are known for spectacular performances by members of the Alyssum Magnetar, exotic food and drink, as well as philosophical and ethical discussions. Here friendships are formed, business deals are struck and old grievances are forgiven. [Root.GetHisHerCap] ability to unite such disparate individuals lays a solid foundation for our future prosperity.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_pacifist2$§!非常受人欢迎，她的能力和声望将大家团聚在一起，团结一致的社会变得更加稳定了。
entries.en: Owing to §Y$NAME_pacifist2$'s§! popularity with the people and her skill at bringing them together, society as a whole has grown more stable.

entries.zh: §Y§![Root.GetName]简直是一位劝诱方面的艺术家。[Root.GetHeSheCap]利用[Root.GetHisHer]的人脉和政治影响力从整个星系收集重要信息。[Root.GetFirstName]把[Root.GetHisHer]所有的知识都保存在一件传家宝里：一块浅绿色的水晶，[Root.GetHeShe]偶尔会在[Root.GetHisHer]的奢华宴会上佩戴。当在特定的光谱下观察时，它的秘密就会以一个壮丽光晕的形式投射出来。现在[Root.GetHeShe]认为是时候利用这些知识造福社会了。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! is a true artiste when it comes to charm and persuasion. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has used [Root.GetHisHer] contacts and political clout to gather vital information from all over the galaxy. [Root.GetFirstName] has kept all of [Root.GetHisHer] knowledge in a family heirloom: a pale green crystal that [Root.GetHeShe] occasionally wears at [Root.GetHisHer] lavish feasts. When held up to a specific spectrum of light, its secrets are projected in a magnificent halo. Now, [Root.GetHeShe] believes the time has come to use this knowledge for the good of society.
It will be put to good use.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!呈递了一个数据库，其中包含了多年来从[Root.GetHisHer]的延伸线人处收集来的敏感信息。这一巨大的数据库包括军事部署计划、秘密研究、意识读取数据在内的等等信息。这些东西当然极具价值，但使用这些信息可能会加剧内部和外部冲突。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! presents a database containing sensitive information gathered over the years from [Root.GetHisHer] extensive contacts. The massive cache includes everything from schematics over military installations, secret research, and extracts from mind probing. What is offered is valuable, but using the information may escalate internal as well as external conflicts.

entries.zh: §Y25%§!概率其他帝国对我们的评价降低§R-25§!。
entries.en: §Y25%§! chance other empires' opinion of us changes by §R-25§!.

entries.zh: 具有关于我们的敏感信息
§Y[Root.GetName]§!在整个星系中继续铺展开[Root.GetHisHer]的线人网络。有些人是自愿告密的，而另一些人则是被勒索或洗脑的。但不管怎么样，[Root.GetHeShe]收集到的信息都会非常有用。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! has grown [Root.GetHisHer] network of contacts throughout the galaxy. Some are willing informants, while others are blackmailed or brainwashed. In any case, the information [Root.GetHeShe] gathers will be extremely beneficial.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]，§!那位奢靡无度的行政官，在[planet_governed.GetName]为[Root.GetHimselfHerself]建造了一座豪华的宫殿。这座宫殿既彰显着[Root.GetHisHer]的权利和财富，也让[Root.GetHisHer]的浮夸和腐朽显露无疑。为了庆祝宫殿落成，[Root.GetHeShe]将举办一场盛大的宴会，所有的显赫人物都受邀出席。[Root.GetHeShe]还会罕见地一示慷慨，与百姓分享一些[Root.GetHisHer]的财富。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§!, the decadent official, has built an extravagant palace for [Root.GetHimselfHerself] on [planet_governed.GetName]. This palace is as much a symbol of [Root.GetHisHer] power and wealth as of [Root.GetHisHer] vanity and corruption. To celebrate its completion, [Root.GetHeShe] will hold a grand feast, to which everyone of importance has been invited. And in a rare show of generosity [Root.GetHeShe] has also shared some of [Root.GetHisHer] riches with the population.

entries.zh: 我们还能指望他什么呢？
这座宏伟的建筑既怪诞又迷人。
entries.en: This monumental building is as grotesque as it is fascinating.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!，那位奢靡无度的行政官，其贪污腐败行为暴露了。这一现象已经持续了挺长的时间，[Root.GetHeShe]不仅将[Root.GetHisHer]的财产存入银行，还藏匿于地下金库和星系各处的深空贮藏中。在面对质问时，[Root.GetHeShe]涕泗横流，拿[Root.GetHimselfHerself]的头抢地，信誓旦旦地保证这些财产的根本目的是为统治者准备的献礼。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§!, the decadent official, has been caught embezzling. This has been going on for quite some time, and [Root.GetHeShe] has stashed [Root.GetHisHer] wealth not just in bank accounts but also in underground vaults and deep space depots all around the galaxy. In face of the charges, [Root.GetHeShe] threw [Root.GetHimselfHerself] to the ground, swearing that these items were intended as gifts for the ruler.

entries.zh: 多年来，神秘人§Y[Root.GetName]§!解读了许多揭示更大命运的征兆和预示。现在，[Root.GetSheHe]宣称预见到了整个星系将会统一在一面旗帜下的画面——而那正是我们的旗帜。真正的辉煌还在后头。
entries.en: For many years, §Y[Root.GetName]§! the Mystic has interpreted signs and portents that reveal a greater destiny. Now, [Root.GetSheHe] claims a vision of the galaxy united under a single banner - our own. The real splendor is still to come.

entries.zh: 伟大的荣耀等待着我们。
§Y$NAME_spiritualist1$§!的关于我们光辉未来的预言激励着人们重燃起热情。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_spiritualist1$'s§! proclamations about our future glory spur the populace to renewed fervor and purpose.

entries.zh: 多年来，§Y[Root.GetName]§!一直通过强大的灵能梦向虚空呼喊。现在，几艘载有许多物种成员的民用飞船出现在[planet_governed.GetName]轨道上。他们愿意为我们服务，以期和他们的先知一起生活。
entries.en: For years, §Y[Root.GetName]§! has been calling out into the void via powerful psionic dreams. Now, several civilian ships carrying members of many species have appeared in orbit around [planet_governed.GetName]. In exchange for a chance to live with their prophet, they are willing to serve us.

entries.zh: 他们将会加入我们的族群。
entries.en: They will be a part of our flock.

entries.zh: 在[event_target:planet_governed.GetName]增加§Y300§!个唯心主义的灵能人口。
档案员§Y[Root.GetName]§!发现了一处远古遗物的储藏地。[Root.GetHeSheCap]从古老的传说和漫游海盗交易的传感器日志中拼凑出他们的行踪信息。这些神秘物体的起源尚不清楚，但通过吸收低频声音，它们会偶然产生轻微的时间扭曲。这项技术应该是有益的。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! the Archivist has discovered a cache of ancient relics. [Root.GetHeSheCap] pieced together information of their whereabouts from old myths and sensor logs traded from roaming pirates. The origin of the mysterious objects remains unclear, but by absorbing low frequency sound, they occasionally produce slight temporal distortions. The technology should prove beneficial.

entries.zh: 档案员§Y[Root.GetName]§!截获了一条奇怪的信息。这些信息在星际间回荡了数千年，受到严重的静电噪音影响。它包含了来自外星文明的问候，以及他们家园的精确位置。这个物种已经灭绝了很长一段时间，但在它们的母星上可能仍然有重要的遗迹和远古的知识有待发现。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! the Archivist has intercepted a strange message. Distorted by static, the message has reverberated between the stars for millennia. It contains a greeting from an alien civilization, as well as the precise location of their home world. The species has been extinct for quite some time, but there may still be important remnants and ancient knowledge to uncover on their home planet.

entries.zh: 谁知道会不会发现什么好东西？
entries.en: Who knows what treasures we might find?
A new archaeological site is discovered on §Y[event_target:nasuz_arcsite_planet.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 我们的综合指挥流程使我们能够创新在战斗中使用攻击舰船的方式。我们也将摆脱烦人的海军部的争吵。
entries.en: Our integrated command processes have allowed us to innovate the way we use strike ships in combat. We will also be rid of the quarrels of the pesky admiralty.

entries.zh: 多亏斯克兰德的洞见，我们能制定出与天灾战斗的有效策略。
entries.en: Thanks to Skrand's insights we were able to devise effective ways to wage our war against the Crisis.

entries.zh: 对利爪号表层装甲进行调研为我们提供了船体优化的思路。这可以在不增加整舰重量的情况下提升舰船的装甲防护能力。
entries.en: Investigation into the Talon's cladding has provided us with insights into hull optimization. This has allowed us to improve the armor of our ships without adding more weight.

entries.zh: 通过研究利爪号的船体，我们对于舰船结构的理解有了相当程度的进展，并且很快就会应用到加固舰船的实际操作之中去。
entries.en: By studying the Talon's hull, we have improved our understanding of ship frames, processes that should be quickly applicable in fortifying our own ships' exteriors.

entries.zh: 我国人民被斯克兰德的陈述所感动，认为他是军事美德的典范，是提醒人们保持警惕的重要人物。
entries.en: Moved by Skrand's testimony, our people regard him as a paragon of military virtue and a crucial reminder of the importance of vigilance.

entries.zh: 我们成功地恢复了[gateway_system.GetName]星系中远古星门的供能！尽管年代久远，这座装置还是形成了一条完全可以供通行的稳定亚空间通路。\n\n我们还检测到了异常的、类似于进出星门时的能量读数，但没有任何船只过境的迹象。
entries.en: We have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.\n\nWe're also detecting unusual energy readings, similar to those that occur when entering or exiting a gate, but without any evidence of a ship in transit.

entries.zh: 一艘巨大的舰船从星门中出现，它的体积之巨大我们前所未见。军队已处于高度戒备状态。\n\n那艘未知舰船对我们的呼叫没有应答，但鉴于它似乎完全处于瘫痪状态，我们暂时不会与它交战。我们仍在进行调查并试图开启通讯。
entries.en: A hulking ship has emerged from the gate, its sheer scale unlike anything we have seen before. Military forces have been put on high alert.\n\nThe unknown vessel is not responding to our hails, but given the fact that it appears completely disabled, we will not engage it for now. Investigation and attempts to open comms continue.

entries.zh: 我们对这艘巨大舰船的调查并没有得到很多信息。然而，我们已经能够破译星门第一次打开时收到的一些数据。看来，这艘舰船已经被困在星门里一段时间了（可能久得难以想象）。\n\n为了了解更多，我们需要登上它。由于这是一艘军舰，建议派遣特种部队。
entries.en: Our investigation into the hulking ship hasn't yielded many answers. However, we have been able to decipher some of the data we received when the gate first opened. It appears that the ship has been stuck inside the gate for an unknown (and possibly incredible) length of time.\n\nTo find out more, we will need to board the ship. As it is a military vessel, sending a special ops unit is advised.

entries.zh: 我们必须登上这艘外星舰船。微弱的能量读数表明其中可能有一个正常运转的生命维持系统。有可能有人或什么东西潜伏在船上。我们的士兵很想知道答案。
entries.en: We must board the alien vessel. Faint energy readings could indicate a functioning life-support system. There is a chance that someone, or something, may be lurking on the ship. Our soldiers are eager to find out.

entries.zh:
在登上舰船后不久，我们就遭遇了一队异形的外星人。由于我们的突然出现，许多外星人受到了惊吓，纷纷拔出武器。谢天谢地，交火得以避免！

在要求双方冷静下来之后，外星人指挥官解释道这艘船需要进行紧急维修。一旦所有系统正常运转，他和他的船员打算返回自己的母星，斯卡拉维德。

这位指挥官全身着军队盛装礼服，其形象十分令人深刻。这艘舰船的船员在提及他时都满怀敬意，其个人魅力甚至影响到了我方人员。他已经营造了双边建立正式外交关系的可能性。
entries.en:
Soon after boarding the vessel, we encountered a group of uniformed aliens. Startled by our sudden appearance, many were quick to draw weapons. Thankfully, a firefight was avoided.

Calling for calm, the alien commander explained that the ship is in need of emergency repairs. Once all systems are operational, he and his crew intend to return to their home planet, Skravird.

Dressed in full military regalia, he certainly cuts an impressive figure. The ship's crew speak of him with reverence, and the force of his personality is palpable even to our people. He has already raised the possibility of establishing formal diplomatic relations.

entries.zh: 在舰船的内部，我们发现了一支外星人团队，他们正在尝试修复舰船的功能。我们的突然出现让他们感觉受到了威胁，许多外星人很快拔出了武器。尽管避免了冲突，这位外星人指挥官显然还是把我们当做了敌人。\n\n他身着全套军服，器宇不凡。即便在我们看来，他的人格魅力也是显而易见的。然而，目前似乎很难进行进一步的沟通。
entries.en: Inside the vessel, we discovered a group of aliens working to restore the ship's functionality. Viewing our sudden appearance as a threat, many were quick to draw weapons. Although violence was avoided, the alien commander clearly views us as adversaries.\n\nDressed in full military regalia, he cuts an impressive figure. The force of his personality is palpable even to us. However, at this point further dialogue seems unlikely.

entries.zh: 帮助指挥官修复他的舰船。
entries.en: Help this commander repair his ship.

entries.zh: 无视他。转而扣押这艘舰船。
entries.en: Ignore him. Seize the ship instead.

entries.zh: 这艘舰船需要进行全面维护。我们自愿支援维修工作。
entries.en: The alien vessel requires extensive maintenance. We have agreed to assist with repairs.

entries.zh: 我们的工程团队已经对外星人船员提供了援助。这艘船的番号大致可以翻译作“利爪一号”，外星指挥官自称斯克兰德·夏普比克，是一位享有盛名的海军上将。\n\n通过对比利爪一号和我们自己的数据，我们确认斯克兰德和他的船员被困在星门里长达几千年。对他们来说，这是一次短暂的旅行，但对星系的其他地方来说，几千年已经过去了。
entries.en: Our engineering team has ably assisted the alien crew. The vessel's designation translates roughly to 'First Talon', and their commander has identified himself as Skrand Sharpbeak, an admiral of renown.\n\nBy comparing data from the First Talon's databanks and our own, we have confirmed that Skrand and his crew were trapped within the gate for several millennia. For them, it was a short trip - but for the rest of the galaxy, thousands of years passed by.

entries.zh: $paragon.3004.intro$\n\n得益于我们对斯卡拉维德的发掘，至少我们已经能向夏普比克司令指出他故乡星球的所在了，但他曾经爱过的所有人和事都早已离去。
entries.en: $paragon.3004.intro$\n\nThanks to our excavation on Skravird, at least we can point Admiral Sharpbeak towards his home planet, but everything and everyone he has have ever loved is long since gone.

entries.zh: $paragon.3004.intro$\n\n他们无家可归，他们曾经爱过的所有人和事都早已离去。
entries.en: $paragon.3004.intro$\n\nThey have no home to return to. Everything and everyone they have have ever loved is long since gone.

entries.zh:
§H利爪一号的舰队司令斯克兰德·夏普比克向我们打了个招呼。他显得精疲力竭。§!

斯卡拉维德陷落了。我的家园不复存在了。数十亿的生命……逝去了。

利爪一号就这么变成了最后一艘利爪号，而我也变成了一个无依无靠的士兵。感谢你们的帮助，我代表我的船员宣誓效忠。
entries.en:
§HAdmiral Skrand Sharpbeak of the First Talon hails us. He appears exhausted.§!

Skravird has fallen. My home is no more. Billions of lives... gone.

The First Talon has become The Last Talon, and I am a soldier without a cause. For your help, and on behalf of my crew, I pledge our allegiance.

entries.zh: 谢谢。但我们也有值得尊敬的指挥官。
entries.en: Our thanks. But we have worthy commanders of our own.

entries.zh: §H斯克兰德眨眨眼咳嗽了起来。§!\n\n我当然知道。但你要知道我的服务不是轻易提供的。作为善意的象征，我会指示我的工程师保持利爪号的运转，并教会你的工程师如何维护它。
entries.en: §HSkrand blinks and coughs.§!\n\nNo doubt. But know that my service is not offered lightly. As a token of goodwill, I will instruct my engineers to keep the Talon operable and teach your engineers how to maintain it.

entries.zh: 那你有什么能耐阻止我们据为己有吗？
entries.en: What is to prevent us from simply taking it ourselves?

entries.zh:
§H夏普比克后退了几步，它的喙发出一连串非常不愉快的吱吱声。§!

这艘船是我已故家乡的荣耀，是工人们用双爪乃至生命建造出来的！这是我们的故土的最后一片残羽，是我们怀念自己幼巢的最后依靠。

§H斯克兰德调整了身姿，冷静下来。§!

简而言之，我会用爪子和喙战斗，至死方休。
entries.en:
§HSharpbeak recoils, his beak issuing a series of highly unpleasant squawks.§!

This ship is the pride of my lost homeland, built with the talons of workers who gave their lives to the project! It's the last piece of our home - all that's left to remind us of our fledgling nests.

§HRegaining his posture, Skrand calms his clacking.§!

Suffice to say, I would fight beak and claw to stop you.

entries.zh: §L很好。我们接受你的效忠。为荣耀而战吧，司令。§!\n$SEPARATOR$\n
entries.en: §LVery well. We accept your pledge. Serve with honor, Admiral.§!\n$SEPARATOR$\n

entries.zh: §H夏普比克舒展了一下羽毛。§!\n\n我会的。利爪终号会以新的身份再度翱翔天际。你让我们找到了继续下去的意义。谢谢你。
entries.en: §HSharpbeak spreads his plummage.§!\n\nI shall. The Last Talon will fly again, albeit under new colors. You have restored our purpose. I thank you.

entries.zh: §L语言总是苍白无力。再会吧，司令。§!
§H夏普比克的目光如炬。§!\n\n那也好。利爪终号将会独自翱翔。再见吧。
entries.en: §HSharpbeak's gaze is piercing.§!\n\nVery well. The Last Talon will fly alone. Farewell.

entries.zh: 我们的士兵轻易地战胜了外星舰船的船员。我们摧毁了他们的防御，清理掉了舰桥上的敌军士兵。这艘船是我们的了！
entries.en: Our troops easily overpowered the vessel's crew. We destroyed their defenses and cleared the bridge of enemy soldiers. The ship is ours!

entries.zh: 我方登录外星舰船的部队遭到了残虐！敌人令人难以置信地凶悍。结束战斗后，我们重启了舰船的战术系统。系统显示，超光速引擎仍然无法启动，但舰船本身正在主动争夺我们的控制权。
entries.en: Our troops aboard the alien vessel were decimated! The ferocity of the defenders was incredible. After the battle, power was returned to the ship's tactical systems. According to our scans, the hyperdrive is still inoperable, but the vessel itself is actively contesting our space.

entries.zh: 在常规调查中，我们发现这艘舰船一直在激活的星门旁警戒，但是对于我们的呼叫没有任何应答，而且其似乎在处于高功率运转状态。
entries.en: During our standard survey, we found a hulking ship standing guard near an activated gate. The vessel is not responding to our summons and appears to be at functioning at critical power levels.

entries.zh: 从斯克兰德和他的人那儿学到的设计经验，这些先进的舰载机可以运用灵活适应的战术进行长时间作战。
entries.en: Learning from the design expertise of Skrand and his people, these superior strike craft are capable of prolonged engagement and highly adaptive tactics.

entries.zh: 随着一种新型瘟疫在舰船上散播开来，利爪一号上的船员们开始陷入恐慌。根据初步的分析判断，对于我们的族群而言，这是一种相对无害的病毒。然而，对于船上的鸟类船员来说情况就不一样了，病毒首先附着在羽毛上，导致羽毛根部感染腐烂，不出几天，感染就会蔓延到血液中。\n\n如果任由这样发展下去，最终会达到不可挽回的地步。
entries.en: Panic grips the crew of the First Talon as a novel disease is sweeping across the ship. According to initial analysis, it's a strain of a relatively harmless virus, common to our people. However, to the avian crew of the Talon, its effects are both serious and disturbing. First manifesting in the plumage, the virus causes feathers to rot at the root. Within days, the rot spreads to the blood.\n\nOver time, it is likely to prove fatal.

entries.zh: 尽管我们用尽全力，但斯克兰德还是倒在了坏羽病的侵袭之下。他的同伴们正准备为此举行一场传统的葬礼仪式。
entries.en: Despite our best efforts, Skrand has succumbed to Feather Rot. His crew are preparing a traditional funeral service.

entries.zh: 尽管我们在利爪一号上采取了严格的隔离措施，但根据斯克兰德刚刚的报告，估计船上约有60%的船员已被感染。
entries.en: Despite our best efforts to quarantine the First Talon, Admiral Skrand has contracted a severe case of Feather Rot. We estimate that 60% of his crew is already sick.

entries.zh: 到目前为止，坏羽病的新症状几乎在一夜之间就涌现出来了，这超出了利爪一号自身医务室的处理极限，船上的走廊里挤满了病患还有奄奄一息的船员。
entries.en: Hitherto unseen symptoms of the Feather Rot epidemic have appeared almost overnight. The First Talon's sickbay is overflowing, and the ship's corridors are full of the sick and dying.

entries.zh: 舰船已经汇报了坏羽病导致的第一例死亡病例。那些鸟类船员目前仍然无法抵御病毒的感染，除非我们能找到治疗方法，不然的话据推算最终死亡率可达95%。
entries.en: The first fatalities of the Feather Rot epidemic have been reported. The avians remain unable to fight off the infection on their own, and unless we find a way a cure, we estimate a mortality rate of 95%.

entries.zh: 在数月的努力后，我们成功治愈了利爪一号上染病的船员们，舰船运转逐步重回正轨。毫无疑问斯克兰德将非常感谢我们在这件事上的帮助。
entries.en: After months of work, we were able to administer a successful treatment to the crew of the First Talon. Efforts are underway to up production. Admiral Skrand will no doubt be very grateful for our help in this matter.

entries.zh: 我们的人员一直在努力促进与斯克兰德和他的船员的关系。这种跨文化交流的努力已经取得初步成效：刚刚斯克兰德同意提供他们高效舰载机的设计。这可能会大大提升我们对太空作战的理解。
entries.en: Our personnel have worked hard to foster relations with Skrand and his crewmates. This effort in cross-cultural exchange is already bearing fruit: Skrand has just agreed to hand over the designs for their highly efficient strike craft. This could lead to a great leap in our understanding of space combat.

entries.zh: 我们对该礼物表达感激
entries.en: We are thankful for this gift.

entries.zh: 历时数月的研究、编写和实验终于提供了一些启发。外星飞船的计算机库包含了舰载机编队的适应性战术。现在这项技术由我们来运用。
entries.en: Months of studying, cataloging, and experimenting finally provided some insight. The alien vessel's computer banks contain adaptive tactics in strike craft formation. Now, this technology is ours to implement.

entries.zh: 虽然我们的基层军官和指挥官正在与斯克兰德密切合作，但他们也不是完全言听计从。双方所习惯的指挥结构不同，带来了一些不必要的紧张局面。因此我们亟需一场联合军事演练。\n\n该演练可能会降低我们指挥舰队的能力，但不能准备好军队的话可能会导致极其严重的后果。
entries.en: Our officers and commanders are working closely with Skrand, but they are not always in accord with him. Their preferred command structures differ, causing unnecessary tension. This has precipitated a need for joint military training.\n\nThe work may limit our ability to command our fleets, but failing to properly prepare the troops could have dire consequences.

entries.zh: 这种军事演习有什么意义么。
双方都取得了显著进展，我们认为联合演训项目取得了巨大成功。我们从斯克兰德那里学到了很多关于近距离太空作战的知识，同时他和他的军官们也熟悉了我们的后勤系统。一种新的乐观主义和同志情谊已经在军队中扎根下来。
entries.en: With exceptional progress on both sides, we consider the joint training program a great success. We learned much from Skrand about close-quarters space combat, while bringing him and his officers up to speed on our logistics practices. A new sense of optimism and camaraderie has taken root.

entries.zh: 主要问题在于我们使用舰载机的战术截然不同。斯克兰德部署了多个大型攻击机小组来打破敌人的指挥链。他们在母舰的明确目标下联合行动。\n\n我们的方法则更灵活，让他们承担一些态势感知型的任务，并去执行高危险高回报的行动，但我们缺乏斯克兰德和他的军官所拥有的大局观。目前，我们还在努力寻找可以一起建立的共同基础。
entries.en: The main problem lies in how differently we employ strike-craft tactics. Skrand deploys multiple large strike-craft teams to break the enemy's chain of command. They operate united by clear objectives from their mother ship.\n\nOur approach is more flexible with roles dictated by situational awareness and the use of potentially high-risk, high-reward actions, but we lack the cohesion seen in Skrand and his officers. For now, we still strive to find a common ground to build on.

entries.zh: 模拟战斗表明，斯克兰德的集中火力战术在最初阶段非常奏效，但很快会被反制战术所克制。即便如此，他战果也还是比起我们的的表现好得多。\n\n同时实施这两种战术会导致混乱。幸运的是，从这些失败中产生了可能想法，这将缓解潜在的问题。
entries.en: Simulation battles have shown Skrand's concentrated tactics are very effective at first, but quickly fail against counter strategies. Even so, the results were superior to those we could expect ourselves.\n\nImplementing parts of both tactics in parallel resulted in chaos. Fortunately, from these failures emerged promising ideas that should alleviate the underlying problems.

entries.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
entries.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and has stated he will leave our service immediately unless we relieve [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName] of their duties.

entries.zh: §L如果在这个问题上选择斯克兰德，我们可能会面临更多的反弹。§!
entries.en: §LWe might face more backlash if we settle with Skrand on this issue.§!

entries.zh: §L采取这一行动将让所有异见者离开海军部。§!
entries.en: §LTaking this action will remove all dissidents from the admiralty.§!

entries.zh: 我们对利爪终号的联合研究得到了对这艘钢铁巨兽内部运作方式的独到见解。我们相信我们的研究团队跟利爪号的船员们通力合作将有可能进一步改进舰船的外部结构，让它面对攻击和船体破坏具有更强的抵抗力。\n\n我们已经获得了斯克兰德的允许，但项目还需要更多资金。
entries.en: Our joint research on the Last Talon has given us unique insights into the inner workings of this behemoth. We believe that our engineering team, in cooperation with those aboard the Talon, have an opportunity to further improve the outer layers of the ship, making it even more resistant to attacks and potential hull breaches.\n\nWe have already received permission from Skrand, but the project will require further funds.
We don't have resources for this.

entries.zh: 虽然我们没能完成预定目标，但还是成功地改进了利爪号的装甲系统。我们的工程师还发现了可以用于改进我们自己舰船的灵感。
entries.en: Although we didn't achieve the desired results, we managed to improve the Talon's armor systems. Our engineers also found valuable insights that can be applied to improve our own ships.

entries.zh: 我们对改进利爪号的结构强度而不牺牲速度或机动性进行了诸多努力，但进展相当缓慢。斯克兰德的工程师虽然帮了我们很多忙，但是他们不愿意我们在没有密切监督的情况下实施我们的想法。尽管如此，工作仍在继续推进。
entries.en: We have made several different attempts to increase the Talon's structural integrity without compromising speed or maneuverability, but progress has been slow. The assistance of Skrands' engineers has been a great boon to us, but they are reluctant to implement our ideas without close supervision. However, work continues to move forward.

entries.zh: 利爪号的部分材料和我们的同类产品不同。这些合金的韧性更差，导致船体在安装额外的装甲板时意外断裂。驻船工程师对我们的监督是正确的，幸好意外发生时他们就在附近。\n\n我们需要使用一些原来用于升级的材料来维修船体，这将会导致整个升级工作的延迟。
entries.en: Some of the Talon's materials differ from our equivalents. Its alloy is much less flexible, which caused the hull to break unexpectedly during the installation of additional armor plates. The ship's engineers were right to oversee our work, and we were lucky they were nearby.\n\nWe had to use some of the materials allocated for improvements to repair the ship, which has in turn delayed the whole operation.

entries.zh: 这是徒劳的，放弃项目吧。

§H闪烁的屏幕上浮现出斯克兰德的指挥界面。这位舰队司令的羽翼蓬立，双眼发出锐利的目光。§!

这些……混账！他们只知道杀戮、破坏！

§H他愤怒地咬紧了喙，继续说。§!

我请求……不，我下令发起战争！我们不能让他们毁掉一切，让我们再次一无所有！我、我相信我们一起可以防止我人民所遭遇的悲剧再度重演。我已经准备好与你们分享我们所知道的一切。
entries.en:
§HThe screen flickers as Skrand's command deck appears. The admiral's feathers are ruffled, his sharp eyes flashing.§!

These... outsiders! They came here only to kill, to destroy!

§HClacking his beak furiously, he continues.§!

I request-- No, I DEMAND that we declare war! We can't let them destroy everything, not again! I... Together I believe we can prevent a repeat of what befell my people. I am ready to teach you everything we know.

entries.zh: 你之前曾和这些威胁交过手吗？
entries.en: Have you come into contact with this threat before?

entries.zh:
不，并没有。但我以前见过这种情况……这种模式再熟悉不过了。威胁是一样的。如果我们不尽快采取行动，我们将遭受到与我的留守同胞们同样的结局。

§H他全身的羽毛支棱了起来。§!

我不会再让任何人遭遇这种不幸了。
entries.en:
No, not exactly. But I've seen this play out before... The pattern is all too familiar. The threat is the same. If we don't act soon, we will meet the same end that once befell my people.

§HHe ruffles his feathers.§!

I would not wish such a fate on anyone.

entries.zh:
我们将这种敌人称为“威胁”。他们从不回复任何通讯请求，更不用说外交，任何挡住他们去路的人后果都是死。

§H他发出了一声尖利的嘶鸣。§!

他们不知从何而来突然出现，烧杀抢掠！我们几乎没有还手能力，但我们知道了与这样的敌人作战意味着什么。常规战争是不够的。一不做，二不休。我们必须消灭他们，一个不留，否则就见不到明天了。
entries.en:
We called our enemy the Menace. They never responded to comms requests, let alone diplomacy, and everyone who got in their way wound up dead.

§HHe emits a high-pitched scream.§!

They appeared out of nowhere, killing, mangling, burning! We had little chance to retaliate, but we learned what it means to fight such an enemy. Conventional warfare isn't enough. It must be total, or nothing. We must destroy all of them, every last one, or there will be no tomorrow.

entries.zh: 时间就是生命。我们必须加快这一进程。我们正面临着彻底毁灭的威胁。我们必须阻止这一切！
entries.en: Time is of the essence. We must expedite the process. We are facing the threat of total destruction. We must prevent this!

entries.zh: 我们不能在这里浪费资源。
entries.en: We can't spend resources on this.

entries.zh: §H斯克兰德尖叫了起来，§!\n\n什么？！不……你犯了个十分严重的错误。
entries.en: §HSkrand shrieks,§!\n\nWHAT?! No... You're making a terrible mistake.

entries.zh: 得益于斯克兰德对“威胁”作战的专长，及其提供的海量数据，我们现在面对这些涌现出来的天灾更加有备无患了。下一步就是将这些知识落到实处。
entries.en: Thanks to Skrand's expertise in warfare against the Menace, and the vast database he has provided, we are now much better equipped to deal with the emerging crisis. All that remains is to put this knowledge to good use.

entries.zh: 我们获得的数据库中可查询到一些斯克兰德的帝国时代这些威胁的作战方式实例。看来，他们使用的策略确实类似于我们今天所面对的那些。他们的舰队不使用正常的物流方案，通常是自给自足的。\n\n更重要的是，干扰技术对他们不怎么起作用。破坏操作同样没有用。
entries.en: The databanks we've accessed provide us with some examples of how the Menace fought during the time of Skrand's empire. It appears that they used tactics similar to those we face today. They rarely use standard logistical schemes, and their fleets are usually self-sufficient.\n\nMore importantly, jamming technology is not as effective against such forces.
