Sabotage operations are likewise useless.

entries.zh: 将我们与斯克兰德的数据进行对比得出了一些有趣的结论。似乎这些敌人相当地古板：它的大型舰队一次只聚焦在一个目标，而忽视其他所有的东西。我们应该可以识别他们的目标，并进行相应的防御。
entries.en: Comparing our own data to Skrand's, we have come to some interesting conclusions. It turns out that the enemy is quite inflexible: its largest fleets focus on one target at a time, to the exclusion of all else. It should be possible to identify such targets and defend accordingly.

entries.zh: 利爪号上的一群工程师帮传达了一条来自斯克兰德的指令。他们请求我们帮助维护利爪号的框架，并让我们的船坞做好修船的准备。如上所述，这些计划代价高昂。而且还有一个问题：考虑到这项工作的微妙性质，斯克兰德将不得不亲自监督该项目。
entries.en: A group of engineers from the Talon has delivered an order from Skrand himself. They requested help to maintain the Talon's frame and prepare our shipyards for potential repairs. As outlined, these plans would be a costly process. And there is one catch: given the delicate nature of the work, Skrand will have to oversee the project himself.

entries.zh: 在我们的帮助下，利爪号的工程师成功地对我们的船坞进行了复古改装，以对利爪号的内部结构进行研究。他们利用我们的实验性的设计改进了他们的超光速引擎，使得即使在发生船体严重损坏的情况下，舰船仍然能够跃迁。虽然使用这种引擎会导致几乎瞬间到达目的地，但是它也会杀死船上的所有人，并且可能使舰船在数年内无法使用。另一方面，如果舰船在战斗中损毁，我们依然能可以尝试激活这个系统并修复残骸。
entries.en: With our help, the Talon's engineers have retrofitted our shipyards to study the Talon's inner workings. Making use of our experimental designs they enhanced their FTL drives, which allow the ship to jump even after a critical hull breach. Although usage of this drive will result in almost instantaneous travel, it will also kill everyone on board and probably render the ship inoperable for years. On the other hand, if the ship is lost in battle, we can try to activate the system and recover the wreckage.

entries.zh: 在利爪号工程师团队的密切支持和监督下，我们成功地重建了船体。利爪号再度启航！
entries.en: With the close support and supervision of the Talon's engineering team, we were able to rebuild the hull. The Talon takes flight again!

entries.zh: 多亏了额外的安全系统以及紧急协议，斯克兰德的旗舰在受到严重损坏后仍成功进行了紧急超光速跃迁。尽管出现在我们首都星球上方的残骸几乎无法被识别为一艘舰船，但船体依然可以作为重建的基础。这些残骸现在正在船坞等待修理。或者，我们可以对船体进行材料回收。考虑到它的状态，即便是我们认定这艘舰船的残骸无法修复的，斯克兰德也会理解这个决定。
entries.en: Thanks to additional failsafe systems and emergency protocols, Skrands' flagship managed to enter emergency FTL even after taking critical damage. Although what appeared in the skies above our capital world is barely recognizable as a ship, the hull can serve as a basis for rebuilding. The remains are now waiting at the docks for repairs. Alternatively, we could the hull for materials. Given its state, even Skrand would understand the decision if we deemed the wreck impossible to repair.
Scrap it, we need the alloys.

entries.zh: 近期在基因工程方面的进展有助于重新恢复舰队司令斯克兰德的种族。也许暂时还不具有相应的基因多样性来确保他们继续繁衍，但用兼容的基因填补空白应该可以完成这项工作。我们现在只需要足够的资金就可以开始行动。
entries.en: Recent developments in genetic engineering could enable us to repopulate Admiral Skrand's species. We may lack the genetic diversity to make them fully capable of reproduction, but filling in the gaps with compatible genes should get the job done. All that is required to get started is adequate funding.

entries.zh: 斯克兰德作出了很多贡献。他完全配得上这个。
entries.en: Skrand has served us well. He deserves this much.
We don't have time for this.

entries.zh: 我们复制斯克兰德DNA的工作某种意义上还是成功了。尽管他们的外观完全一致，但是克隆体的基因组成与斯克兰德的完全不同，它们构成了一个新物种。他们开始称自己为塔隆人。
entries.en: Our efforts to replicate Skrand's DNA have been more or less successful. Although their appearance is identical, the genetic makeup of the clones is different enough from Skrand's that they constitute a new species. We are told they have taken to calling themselves the Talons.

entries.zh: §L塔隆人将会出现在我们的母星上。§!
entries.en: §LThe Talons will appear on our homeworld.§!

entries.zh: 斯克兰德的鸟类DNA远比预想的要顽固，以至于有必要将其他鸟类的基因拼接起来。这个方法并不理想，但应该能让我们完成这项工作。
entries.en: Skrand's avian DNA is far more rigid than expected, so much so that it has been necessary to splice genes from other avian species. The approach is not ideal, but it should allow us to finish the job.

entries.zh: §H斯克兰德的制服一尘不染，他的羽翼油光发亮。§!\n\n我已经看到了你们小小基因实验的成果。虽然这些克隆体还差强人意，但我相当感谢你们的努力。
entries.en: §HSkrand's uniform is in perfect condition, his feathers well groomed.§!\n\nI saw the result of your little genetic experiment. These clones are far from perfect, but I am grateful for your attempt.
We are sorry to hear that.

entries.zh: 不必遗憾。这些克隆体让我们可以重温过去的生活方式。假以时日他们甚至还能孵出雏鸟。你们给予了我们希望。我们对此表示感谢。愿你的羽翼光洁生辉。
entries.en: Do not be. These clones will provide us with a way to live as we did in the past. In time, it may even be possible to have nestlings. You have given us hope. We thank you for that. May your plumage shine.

entries.zh: 我们收到了一份来自许多利爪号船员的请求。他们要求我们调配资源研究他们民族的过往。在利爪号徘徊于亚空间的时候发生了许多许多事情。他们希望能为子孙后代记录下一些东西。
entries.en: We received a request from several members of the Talon's crew. They have asked us to use our resources to research their people's past. Much occurred while the Talon lay in limbo. They have asked that it be recorded for posterity.

entries.zh:
我们收到了关于斯克兰德和他的人民历史的第一份报告:

在他们的时代，星系广阔而未知，星系外边缘被视为太过危险，无法探索。

在星系中心周围，庞大的帝国在争夺权力。其中一个是鸟类文明。在其他人不敢涉足的黑暗之地，这些勇敢的探险家看到了机遇。大迁徙就这样开始了。
entries.en:
We have the first report on the history of Skrand and his people:

In their time the galaxy was vast and unknown, the outer rims considered too dangerous to explore.

Around the galactic center, vast empires vied for power. One was an avian civilization. Where others saw darkness, these intrepid explorers glimpsed opportunity. So began the Great Migration.

entries.zh:
这里附上另一份关于斯克兰德及其人民的历史的报告：

大迁徙在很久以前就结束了。偏安于星系的一隅，斯克兰德的人民们享受着和平而繁荣的日子。但成平日久的他们，没有做好应对威胁的准备。

攻击者不宣而战。没有一双翅膀来得及张开，尖牙立喙也失去了光芒。这些无面入侵者从太空而来，轰炸了鸟类的行星，留下了尸山血海。
entries.en:
Here follows another report on the history of Skrand and his people:

The Migration was long over. Secure along the galaxy's outer rim, Skrand's kin enjoyed both peace and prosperity. But having traded vigilance for comfort, they were unprepared for the coming Menace.

The attackers came without warning. No wings were unfurled; neither talon nor beak flashed in combat. From space the faceless invaders bombed the avian worlds. In their wake they left only death.

entries.zh:
我们收到了下一份关于斯克兰德及其人民的历史的报告：

斯卡拉维德的政府崩溃了，经济也在废墟中陷入停止。但人民的英勇丝毫未减。在远离前线的地方，一个项目正在酝酿之中。

一艘史无前例的舰船将被建造出来。其规模之大足以使敌人胆战心惊。当利爪一号准备就绪时，它被划入了斯卡拉维德最后一位指挥官的指挥之下。年轻又未经考验的斯克兰德·夏普比克上了战场。很快，他的人民就会把他称为威胁克星，斯卡拉维德的第一利爪。
entries.en:
We've received another report on the history of Skrand and his people:

Skravird's government collapsed. Its economy lay in ruins. But the valor of its people was undiminished. Far from the front lines, a project was hatched.

A ship would be built unlike any that had come before. Its sheer scale would strike terror into enemy. When the First Talon was ready, it was placed under the command of the last of Skravird's commanders. Young and untested, Skrand Sharpbeak went to war. Soon his people would hail him as Menace Bane, First Claw of Skravird.

entries.zh: 以下是斯克兰德和他的人民历史的最后一份汇报：\n\n利爪一号，同时也是最后一号，穿过敌人的阵线。船员和指挥官的精明和勇敢带来了一场又一场的胜利。然而，它的航程是短暂的：即使是像利爪号这样的船，也不可能凭一己之力扭转战局。无奈之下，斯克兰德和他的军官们计划在斯克兰德的最后一次防御战中玉石俱焚。在一次包抄敌人的大胆行动中，斯克兰德命令利爪号进入一个未经测试的星门。他和利爪号便从此失去了音信。
entries.en: Thus reads the final report on the history of Skrand and his people:\n\nThe First Talon, first and last of its line, cut through the enemy ranks. Battle after battle was won by the cunning and valor of its crew and their commander. Alas, its flight was short lived: no ship, not even one such as the Talon, could turn the tide of war on its own. In desperation, Skrand and his officers planned to sacrifice themselves in the last defense of Skravird. In a daring bid to outflank the enemy, Skrand ordered the Talon into an untested Gateway. Neither he nor the Talon were ever heard from again.

entries.zh: §R该遗址必须由§Y凯德斯§!自行发掘。§!
entries.en: §RThis site must be excavated by §YKeides§! himself.§!

entries.zh: §L该项目可能花费非常高昂，且一旦开始我们便无法停止。§!
entries.en: §LThis project might be costly, and we will be unable to cancel it once we begin.§!

entries.zh: 进展取决于我们对该计划的态度。
entries.en: Progress is based on our approach to the project.

entries.zh: 被称为“坏羽病”的致命疾病影响了斯克兰德的大部分船员。我们的预见到了结果的严峻。目前，我们只能通过提供适当的护理和处理症状来限制疾病的传播。
entries.en: The virulent disease known as Feather Rot has affected most of Skrand's crew. Our forecasts predict a grim outcome. For now, we can only limit the spread of the disease by providing proper care and dealing with the symptoms.

entries.zh: 我们会按应对潜在致命疫情的标准进行操作。
entries.en: We will follow standard protocols for a potentially deadly outbreak.

entries.zh: 投资医疗研究，维持严格的防疫措施应当能阻止疾病蔓延。
entries.en: Investing in clinical research while maintaining a strict quarantine should limit the spread of the disease.

entries.zh: 不投入足够的医疗资源，疫情会以很快的速度发展。
entries.en: Without the resources to provide adequate care, the disease will progress much faster.

entries.zh: 就像其他任何新疾病，要应对坏羽病，研究总是第一位的。科研团队正在夜以继日地工作寻找治愈方法，我们的医疗人员则在竭力缓解症状，延缓疫情的发展。
entries.en: As with any new disease, lab work is paramount in combating Feather Rot. Research teams are working tirelessly to find a cure, while our medical personnel are fighting to ease symptoms and limit the spread of the disease.

entries.zh: 我们基于新型传染病和医疗保健的经验组建了一系列研究团队。他们的目标是找到治愈方法，同时也要优先其他任务。
entries.en: Research teams are assembled based on experience in novel diseases and health care. Their goal is to find a cure while also prioritizing other tasks.

entries.zh: 我们基于新型传染病和医疗保健的经验组建了一系列研究团队。他们的首要目标是找到治愈方法，而不是缓解症状或阻止疫情蔓延。
entries.en: Research teams are assembled based on experience in novel diseases and health care. Priority is placed on finding a cure rather than easing symptoms or limiting the spread of the disease.

entries.zh: 我们不能为此牺牲自己的科研进度，只有一些志愿者来进行坏羽病的治疗。这将会严重拖缓我们的进度。
entries.en: We cannot sacrifice our research capabilities - only volunteers are working on a treatment for Feather Rot. This will seriously slow our progress.

entries.zh: 指挥整合计划关注与缓解海军指挥层的内斗，特别是斯克兰德和我们的人之间的矛盾。寻找到紧张局面的根源可以改善我们指挥流程的效率。
entries.en: The command integration project focuses on easing infighting within the admiralty, especially between Skrand and our own personnel. Addressing the root causes of the tension could improve the efficacy of our command processes.

entries.zh: 联合工程团队发现了一种在利爪号的最核心部分安装额外装甲层的方式。只要有时间和资源，我们就可以切实提升它的防御能力。
entries.en: Joint engineering teams have found a way to install additional layers of armor around the most critical parts of the Talon. Given the time and resources, we will certainly succeed in bolstering its defenses.

entries.zh: 我们被一股强大的力量所袭扰，这些东西试图摧毁我们所熟知的星系中的一切生命。斯克兰德提供了他的专业知识以及利爪号日志中相关的数据，但我们还需要一段时间才能完成全面的分析。
entries.en: We are beset by powerful forces that seek to destroy life in the galaxy as we know it. Skrand has offered his expertise as well as relevant data from the Talon's logs, but it will be some time before we can complete a comprehensive analysis.

entries.zh: 通过对利爪号设计的研究，我们可以从其建造方式中受益，并帮助其团队进行维护。
entries.en: By studying the design of the Talon, we can learn from its construction and better help its team with maintenance.

entries.zh: 利爪号被毁了。但我们已有的知识应该足以将回收来的残骸作为基础，使其能够重新运转。
entries.en: The Talon was destroyed. But given all we have learned, we should be able to use its recovered remains as a base to make it operational once again.

entries.zh: 由于我们对基因科技的精通，斯克兰德的民族可以被复原出来，这能给他们带去希望，并给我们的帝国带来一个全新的开始。
entries.en: Given our expertise in genetics, we should be able to revive Skrand's people, giving them hope and a fresh start in our empire.

entries.zh: 借助利爪的资料库，学习斯克兰德和他的人民的历史可以提供许多独到的见解。
entries.en: Studying the history of Skrand and his people via the Talon's data banks should provide a number of unique insights.

entries.zh: 可持续的资助可以保证项目正常推进的同时又不给我们的经济带来太大的负担。
entries.en: Sustainable financing will allow the project to move forward without overburdening our economy.

entries.zh: 慷慨的资助会让进展加快，但可能会对我们的经济带去负面影响。
entries.en: Generous funding will greatly enhance progress but may come with negative economic effects.

entries.zh: 最低资助会显著缩短进展速度，但面对经济危机时可能是一种更保险的策略。
entries.en: Minimal funding will slow progress considerably, but can be a prudent strategy in times of economic crisis.

entries.zh: 在我们有能力支付经费之前项目将陷入停滞。
entries.en: The project will be halted until such a time as we can afford it.

entries.zh: 可持续的自主可以保证项目正常推进的同时又不给我们的经济带来太大的负担。我们的进展将取决于进行该项目的科学家的数量。
entries.en: Sustainable financing will allow the project to move forward without overburdening our economy. Our progress is based on the number of scientists working on this project.

entries.zh: 低资助会显著缩短进展速度，但面对经济危机时可能是一种更保险的策略。我们的进展将取决于进行该项目的科学家的数量。
entries.en: Low funding will slow progress considerably, but can be useful in times of economic crisis. Our progress is based on the number of scientists working on this project.

entries.zh: 在暴力和苦难中，这个文明在一位领袖的领导下走向了统一。通过压制较弱的派系来巩固权力，他们现在成为了科学和技术进步的坚定倡导者。在这之后，是一段不稳定的和平的时期。但和平终究是一种短暂的状态。
entries.en: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace has descended. But peace rarely lasts.

entries.zh:
我们的文明总是冲突不断。帝国和王国一个又一个的崛起，又往往一个接一个在内乱的压力下崩溃消亡。

当我们的星球又一次被战火所吞噬时，这种极端的文化再次达到了顶峰。就在一片混沌当中，一位领袖出现了。[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetName]用[owner.Ruler.GetHisHer]的无私奉献、人格魅力和权力制度成功地组织其了追随者。终于有那么一位能够稳定地联合起我们的人了。

统一是一个漫长而痛苦的过程，但在[owner.Ruler.GetTitle]对星际文明未来的允诺下，挑起战火的势力一个接着一个投降并被纳入麾下。我们第一次拥有了长达上百年的和平，但在表面下，各种新仇旧怨也正在暗流涌动。
entries.en:
Our civilization has always been prone to conflict. Empires and kingdoms rose, but never lasted, always collapsing under the pressure of internal strife.

This culture of polarization climaxed when our world was consumed by war. Amidst chaos, a leader emerged. The [owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetName] managed to assemble a gathering of followers who were drawn to [owner.Ruler.GetHisHer] selflessness, charisma and authority. Finally someone was poised to unite us.

The Unification was a long and painful process, but one after another the warring factions eventually surrendered and fell in line, cowed by the [owner.Ruler.GetTitle]'s promises of a future amongst the stars. For the first time in centuries, we have peace, but under the surface, the scars of the old grievances run deep.

entries.zh: 在政治动荡中，没有了光耀者的指引，人们必须在星系中开辟自己的道路。
entries.en: Amidst political turmoil, and without the Luminary's guidance, the people must make their own way in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 使用君临天下起源无法改变权力制度。
entries.en: Can't change Authority with Under One Rule Origin

entries.zh: 伟大学院是我们中的最杰出者之家。继续提升他们的思想将有利于新的领袖，并使我们能够教育子孙后代。
entries.en: The Grand Academy is home to our best and brightest. Continuing to elevate their minds will benefit new leaders and allow us to educate future generations.

entries.zh: 凭借我们领袖的意志力，我们能够在太空中扩展我们帝国的议程，并迫使其他人听从我们的命令。
entries.en: Through the sheer willpower of our leader, we are able to extend our empire's agenda across space, and force others to heed our command.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国致力于创造一个管理更完善、更稳定的政府。
entries.en: Our empire has focused on creating a better-managed and more stable government.

entries.zh: $paragon_origin_strengthened_government_i_desc$特殊课程和政府职位的预筛选是实现这一目标的先决条件。
entries.en: $paragon_origin_strengthened_government_i_desc$ Special courses and pre-screening for government positions are a prerequisite to achieving this goal.

entries.zh: 这座不起眼的纪念碑是为了纪念我们光荣的、把国家带向了星空的领袖。
entries.en: This modest monument is a tribute to our glorious leader, who elevated our nation to the stars.

entries.zh: 这座富丽堂皇的纪念碑是为了纪念第一批定居者，他们和我们光荣的领袖一起，征服了这片狂野但富饶的土地。
entries.en: This opulent monument commemorates the first settlers who, along with our glorious leader, tamed these wild and bountiful lands.

entries.zh: 这座住宅纪念碑象征着我们敬爱的统治者的智慧。它既是一件艺术品，也是一个舒适的居住场所。
entries.en: This residential monument demonstrates the wisdom of our beloved ruler. It is both a piece of art and a comfortable place to live.

entries.zh: 多股海盗实力互相勾结，开始袭扰我们的边境。该局势会严重危害我们的太空航路。
entries.en: Various pirate groups have banded together to conduct smuggling operations on our borders. The situation has greatly endangered our space routes.

entries.zh: 改革派要求在全国范围内进行刑事赦免。虽然大多数人是作为政治异议者被关押的，但毫无疑问的是，一些危险分子也被释放了。
entries.en: Reformists have demanded empire-wide criminal pardons. While most were being held as political dissidents, there is no doubt that some dangerous individuals were also released.

entries.zh: 我们的标准通讯阵列有故障，无非继续为我们边境上遥远的殖民地提供稳定的连接。\n\n完成特殊项目以移除$paragon_origin_comms_down$。
entries.en: Our standard communication arrays are faulty. They no longer provide proper connection to the faraway colonies on the edges of our borders.\n\nComplete Special Project to remove $paragon_origin_comms_down$.

entries.zh: 工人负担过重、情绪低落，无法再完成额外的订单。我们公民所需要完成的巨额工作量显然正在酿成苦果。\n\n完成特殊项目以移除$paragon_origin_worker_strike$。
entries.en: Workers are overburdened, unhappy, and unable to meet excessive quotas. The titanic effort required of our citizens is clearly taking its toll.\n\nComplete Special Project to remove $paragon_origin_worker_strike$.

entries.zh: 传言称有一群低级军官对我们帝国目前的状态抱有异见。这群人正在招募更多的公民加入他们的行列。\n\n完成特殊项目以移除$paragon_origin_military_dissidents$。
entries.en: Rumors indicate that a group of low-ranking military officers are dissatisfied with our empire's current approach. The group is trying to recruit more citizens to join their cause.\n\nComplete Special Project to remove $paragon_origin_military_dissidents$.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国被猖獗的裙带关系所困扰，严重阻碍了正常运作。职位被朋友、家人和各种有关系的人填补，而不是交由德才兼备的人。\n\n完成特殊项目以移除$paragon_origin_nepotism$。
entries.en: Our empire is plagued by rampant nepotism, which hinders our operations. Positions are filled by friends, family members, and people with connections - not by those of merit.\n\nComplete Special Project to remove $paragon_origin_nepotism$.

entries.zh: 我们做了个交易来安抚我们的敌人。我们做出了让步，给予了自由，但我们必须确保他们不会滥用这一安排。
entries.en: We made a deal to placate our enemies. Concessions were made, and freedoms were granted, but we must ensure that they don't abuse this arrangement.

entries.zh: 我们做了个交易来安抚敌人。我们做出了让步，包括允许他们自由地推行自己的诸多议程等等。他们将得到特殊保护，并允许对一些立法机构施加影响。从积极的方面来看，我们的公民将从中受益，并为他们新获得的自由感到高兴。
entries.en: We made a deal to placate our enemies. Concessions were made, including granting them the freedom to pursue many of their agendas. They will receive special protections and influence over some of our legislative bodies. On the positive side, our citizens will reap some of the benefits, and are happy with their newfound freedoms.

entries.zh: 有报道称，民主派正在迅速获得支持者。我们的安全部队目前正在观察他们的成长和行为。
entries.en: Reports state that the democratic faction is quickly gaining supporters. Our security forces are currently observing their growth and behavior.

entries.zh: 由于允诺落空，整个帝国几乎每颗星球上的普通公民都在抗议。
entries.en: Due to our broken promise, ordinary citizens are protesting on almost every planet across the empire.

entries.zh: 光耀者死了! 这个消息震撼了民众。突如其来的失去领袖让社会陷入了困境，因为人们提出了多项改革，政客们也在争夺权力。
entries.en: The Luminary is dead! This news has rocked the populace. The sudden lack of leadership has left society reeling, as multiple reforms are proposed and politicians contend for power.

entries.zh: 我们是一个重新获得平等和团结意识的民族。我们比以往任何时候都更加强大，摆脱了暴君的统治，无论好坏，我们都将独立自主。
entries.en: We are a people renewed with a sense of equality and unity. Stronger than ever, and freed from our despot, we will rule on our own, for better or worse.

entries.zh: 我们仰望星空，鼓舞他人，解放他人。我们焕然一新的海军已经准备好将平等带到星系最遥远的角落。
entries.en: We look to the stars and beyond, to uplift and free others. Our renewed navy is ready to bring equality to the farthest corners of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 寻找内心的平静一直是我们社群的目标，而我们最终实现了。虽然我们为此付出了高昂的代价，但现在是时候收获回报了。
entries.en: Finding inner peace has always been the goal of our community, and we finally managed to achieve it. Although we paid for it dearly, now it is time to reap the rewards.

entries.zh: 最近的动荡向我们表明，向外部势力开放可能会带来冲突和痛苦。我们需要在未来保护自己不受此类威胁。
entries.en: The recent upheaval showed us that being open to external powers can bring strife and misery. We need to safeguard ourselves from such threats in the future.

entries.zh: 最近的动乱表明，封闭于外部力量会导致冲突和痛苦。我们需要开放自己，这样我们就不会在未来错过类似的机会。
entries.en: The recent upheaval showed us that being closed to external forces can lead to strife and misery. We need to open ourselves up so we do not miss similar opportunities in the future.

entries.zh: 在星系内战的战火中铸就的新社会知道他们工作的价值。我们一起努力定能实现我们所有的目标。
entries.en: The new society, forged in the fires of galactic civil war, knows the worth of their work. Together we strive to accomplish all of our goals.

entries.zh: 我们经历了惨痛的教训。内战教会了我们克制和内心平静的重要性。必须坚决反对一切腐败和堕落。
entries.en: We learned our lessons the hard way. Our civil war taught us restraint and the importance of inner peace. Decadence and corruption must be opposed at every turn.

entries.zh: 自大一统以来，我们的公民第一次真正站在一起。经过最近的改革，我们的帝国比以往任何时候都强大。
entries.en: For the first time since the Unification, our citizens truly stand together. With the recent reforms, our empire is stronger than ever.

entries.zh: 经过多年的内乱，人民终于团结起来了。而如今，当我们把目光转向星空时，一种新的冲突来源出现了。我们再次遭受战争的蹂躏，争权夺势迫在眉睫。
entries.en: After long years of civil strife, the population was at last united. But now, as we turn our gaze to the stars, a new source of conflict emerges. Once more we are ravaged by war, and the struggle for supremacy is upon us.

entries.zh: 仅仅把我们的人民团结在太空殖民的共同事业中是不够的。虽然这个国家饱受内战的蹂躏，但效忠者们坚定地支持着统治者，面对威胁他们生活方式和我们敬爱的统治者的叛徒时，他们挺身而出。
entries.en: It was not enough to unite our people in the common cause of space colonization. Though the nation has been ravaged by civil war, loyalists are steadfast in their support of the throne, standing strong in the face of traitors who threaten their way of life and our beloved ruler.

entries.zh: 鉴于近年来对行政的需求保持这令人难以置信的增长态势，内阁难以适应其日益增长的职责压力。
entries.en: Given the tremendous bureaucratic strain in recent years to sustain incredible growth, the council has encountered difficulties adjusting to their growing responsibilities.

entries.zh: 这台古老的机器已经深深根植于我们行星上的政府避难所。作为我们敬爱的统治者的聪明才智的遗迹，其物质复制技术仍然是我们无法理解的。
entries.en: This ancient machine is nestled deep within government vaults on our planet. A relic of the ingenuity of our beloved ruler, its matter replication technology remains incomprehensible to us.

entries.zh: 这台非凡的装置深藏在政府大楼里。作为我们敬爱的统治者的聪明才智的遗珍，它的内部工作原理对我们来说几乎是魔法。它能让我们维持统治者的生命。这种胶囊只适合一种特定的DNA序列。失去或迁移首都对依赖其生存的人来说就意味着死亡。
entries.en: This extraordinary contraption is nestled deep within the government building. A relic of the ingenuity of our beloved ruler, its inner workings are almost magical to us. It allows us to sustain the life of our ruler. The capsule is tailored to only one specific DNA sequence. Losing or moving our capital will mean certain death for the one encased within it.

entries.zh: §G光耀者会随着时间的推移而不断增强力量。§!\n\n统一战争相当地残酷。最后，是[Root.GetName]将和平和意义带给了我们。光耀者是一座象征着我们整个物种所能达成成就的活着的丰碑，也激励着所有的人。[This.Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Desc]
entries.en: §GThe Luminary grows in power over time.§!\n\nThe Unification Wars were a brutal affair. In the end, [Root.GetName] brought peace and purpose to us all. The Luminary is the living symbol of what our species can achieve, and an inspiration to all.[This.Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Desc]

entries.zh: $leader_trait_legendary_leader$的子嗣。继承他们前任的遗产将是一项巨大的挑战，但这位领导人表现出了巨大的潜力。
entries.en: The Heir to the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$. Living up to their predecessor's legacy will be a challenge, but this leader already shows great promise.

entries.zh: §L数千年的基因实验和战争造就了一个极具适应力的物种。§!
entries.en: §LMillennia of genetic experimentation and war have led to the creation of a highly resilient species.§!

entries.zh: 这位领袖将作为臭名昭著的代表载入史册。
entries.en: This leader will go down in history as a figure of great notoriety.

entries.zh:
§P能量外溢：§!
在一次灵能仪式之后，这位领袖成为了通往虚境的媒介。我们所有人的灵能被引导到[Root.GetHimHer]身上，使这位领袖成为一尊准神。然而，这种力量是有代价的，我们必须牺牲其他灵能个体来维持媒介渠道。
十年间维护费：§R[owner.paragon_origin_ascension]§!£pop£ $POPS$
entries.en:
§PPower Overflowing:§!
After a psionic ritual, this leader became a conduit to the Shroud. The psionic energy of our entire people is channeled into [Root.GetHimHer], making this leader a quasi-divine being. However, such power comes at a cost, and we must sacrifice other psionic individuals to maintain the conduit.
Decennial Upkeep: §R[owner.paragon_origin_ascension]§! £pop£ $POPS$

entries.zh:
§P地核之心：§!
从地核中形成，这一独特的义体植入体需要持续输入£sr_dark_matter£$sr_dark_matter$来维持其有效性。
entries.en:
§PCore Heart:§!
Formed from a planetary core, this unique cybernetic implant requires a constant supply of £sr_dark_matter£ $sr_dark_matter$ to maintain its efficiency.

entries.zh:
§P肉体永恒：§!
通过创建一台独特的正电子脑并将其装入活性金属躯体，我们将$leader_trait_legendary_leader$复活了。为了维系[Root.GetHimHer]的存在，我们需要持续供应£sr_living_metal£$sr_living_metal$。
entries.en:
§PFlesh Eternal:§!
By creating a unique positronic brain and encasing it inside a Living Metal body, we brought the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ back to life. To sustain [Root.GetHimHer] we need a constant supply of £sr_living_metal£ $sr_living_metal$.

entries.zh:
§P重铸基因：§!
在无数次尝试将$leader_trait_legendary_leader$的基因拼接如其他天赋异禀的个体中，一位试验品成功地在手术中存活下来并呈现出了有益形状。然而，为了维持遗传性状的稳定性需要定期注入新的基因材料。
十年度维护费：§R[owner.paragon_origin_ascension]§!£pop£ $POPS$
entries.en:
§PRestored Genes:§!
After several attempts at splicing the DNA of the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$ into other talented individuals, a single patient managed to survive the operation and develop beneficial traits. However, new genetic material needs to be injected regularly to maintain genomic stability.
Decennial Upkeep: §R[owner.paragon_origin_ascension]§! £pop£ $POPS$

entries.zh: 一位接触的军事指挥官，深受官兵爱戴。
entries.en: A brilliant military commander, loved by the troops.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是星舰武器系统的专家，为舰队作战带来了无价的知识。
entries.en: An expert in starship weapons systems, this leader brings invaluable knowledge to fleet warfare.

entries.zh: 这位领袖表现出非凡的教书育人能力，并将帮助他人充分发挥他们的潜力。
entries.en: This leader displays exceptional educational skills, and will help others to reach their full potential.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是自我约束的典范，是所有人的楷模。
entries.en: This leader is a model of self-discipline, and an inspiration to all.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是天生的权威，几乎没有人敢违抗此人决定。
entries.en: Authority comes naturally to this leader, and few dare contest their decisions.

entries.zh: 只凭其功绩，这位领袖就获得了其他贵族家族尊敬和忠诚。
entries.en: By merit alone, this leader earned the respect and loyalty of the other noble houses.

entries.zh: 这位领袖喜欢炫耀武力。恰当的威慑胜过千言万语。
entries.en: This leader favors displays of power. A well-placed threat is sometimes worth a thousand words.

entries.zh: 通过提供最好的条件，我们可以吸引最聪明的人才。这位领袖专门招聘符合条件的人员。
entries.en: By offering the best, we can attract the brightest minds. This leader specializes in the recruitment of qualified personnel.

entries.zh: 这位领袖会努力争取国家实现内部大循环。
entries.en: This leader will strive to ensure the nation's self-sufficiency.

entries.zh: 魅力超凡、关心人民、无私奉献，这位领袖致力于提升每一个人的生活水平。
entries.en: Charismatic, caring and selfless, this leader seeks to improve quality of life for all.

entries.zh: 这位领袖认为健康的经济是所有伟大国家的根基。
entries.en: This leader sees a healthy economy as the foundation of any great nation.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是机器人学的先锋，也是我们劳动力自动化领域的首席研究员。
entries.en: This leader is a pioneer in robotics and our lead researcher in workforce automation.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对遗传操纵方面的造诣是传奇的。
entries.en: This leader's flair for genetic manipulation is legendary.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对安全和加密协议非常严格，并亲自监督我们的情报部门。
entries.en: This leader is extremely rigorous with security and encryption protocols, and personally oversees our intelligence department.

entries.zh: 这位领袖冷酷无情，直言不讳，经常在外交上犯错误。
entries.en: Callous and very direct, this leader regularly makes diplomatic blunders.

entries.zh: 这位领袖具有挑衅性和对抗性，喜欢冲突，无论是社会冲突还是军事冲突。
entries.en: Provocative and adversarial, this leader enjoys conflict, be it social or martial.

entries.zh: 这位领袖很容易粗心大意，经常忘记不那么重要的任务。
entries.en: This leader is easily distracted and often forgets about less important tasks.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对任何问题的回答都是残酷的镇压，这导致了与当地居民关系的疏远。
entries.en: This leader's answer to any issue is brutal oppression, which alienates the local population.

entries.zh: 这位领袖很容易轻信他人，原谅过错。有些人经常利用这点。
entries.en: This leader is too trusting and forgiving. Others find it easy to abuse these qualities.

entries.zh: 这位领袖害怕承担责任，经常过分小心，在工作流程中经常施加过度的检查和冗余。
entries.en: Terrified of risks, this leader is overly cautious, and implements excessive checks and redundancies in their workflow.

entries.zh: 这位领袖厌恶平庸，经常因为极轻微的错误就解雇一些有才华的人。
entries.en: This leader abhors mediocrity, often dismissing talented people for even the slightest mistake.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的偏执妄想驱使[Root.GetHimHer]走向孤立。
entries.en: This leader's paranoid delusions are driving [Root.GetHimHer] towards isolation.

entries.zh: 由于该领袖偏执的症状不断恶化，其对我们§Y劳工§!和§Y专家§!产出的控制弱化了，同时还降低了我们的§Y凝聚力§!产出。
entries.en: As this leader's paranoia compounds, their control over our §YWorker§! & §YSpecialist§! output will worsen and they will lower our §YUnity§! production.

entries.zh: §H传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。§!
entries.en: §HThe transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.§!

entries.zh: §H§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。§!
entries.en: §H§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.§!
We are closer to the goal!

entries.zh: 我们只能选取§G[ROOT.paragon_origin_ascension]升级§!，否则§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!将无法在此操作后继续存活。
entries.en: We can only pick §G[ROOT.paragon_origin_ascension] Upgrades§!, otherwise there is no chance for §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! to survive this operation.

entries.zh: 解锁§G伟大学院§!£building£建筑，为我们的领袖和帝国提供加成。
entries.en: Unlocks the §GGrand Academy§! £building£ building, providing bonuses to our leaders and our empire.

entries.zh: §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!结束了我们的内斗，带来了大一统。[Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap]在一个爱国团结的帝国中上独掌大权，允诺带领我们去到繁星间，并创建一个伟大的星际帝国。\n\n今天，我们的人民已经失去了耐心，异见的声音正在拷问我们的领袖是否有能力胜任。内阁准备了一个三十年的计划来让他们息声，并带领我们的物种走向一个新的时代。
entries.en: §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! put an end to our internal strife and brought about the Unification. [Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap] came to power on a platform of patriotic unity and imperialism, promising to lead us into the stars and create a grand galactic empire.\n\nToday, our people grow impatient, and dissident voices question our leadership abilities. The council has prepared several 40-year plans that will put these doubts to rest, and propel us into the next age of our species.

entries.zh: 解锁统一承诺议程，在§Y统一承诺§!局势的期间改善基于思潮的议程。
entries.en: Unlocks the Unifying Promise Agenda which improves Ethic-based Agendas for the duration of the §YUnifying Promise§! Situation.

entries.zh: 在大一统期间，§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!发誓总有一天我们的人民将会在其他的星球定居。对许多人而言，这一誓言成了一种先知式的预言。而其他人却很怀疑这能否真的实现。尽管最近超光速科技已经取得了进展，有一小撮人开始利用这一尚未兑现的诺言来破坏§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的统治。\n\n让这些异见者闭嘴的最好办法就是证明他们是错的。我们会启程去往星间，在新的星球定居，将我们的疆域拓展到越远越好。
entries.en: During the Unification period, §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! swore that one day our people would settle on other planets. To many, that vow has become an almost prophetic promise. Others doubt it will ever become a reality. Recently, and despite advances in FTL technology, some have started using this unfulfilled promise to undermine the rule of §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!.\n\nThe surest way to silence these dissidents is to prove them wrong. We will take to the stars, settle new worlds and expand our borders as much as possible.

entries.zh: 我们可有40年去完成这项诺言！
entries.en: We have 40 years to fulfill the promise!
Finish the §Y$council_agenda_origin_legendary_leader_name$§! Agenda to unlock this Approach.
We will focus on internal affairs.

entries.zh: 我们会关注寻找新资源。
entries.en: We will focus on finding new resources.

entries.zh: 我们会将重点放在工程建设。
entries.en: We will focus on engineering works.

entries.zh: 我们要加大研究的投入。
entries.en: We will intensify our research efforts.

entries.zh: 对手给予我们40年的时间去完成允诺。他们很快会意识到质疑我们是多么地愚蠢。
entries.en: The opposition gave us 40 years to fulfill our promises. They shall soon realize how wrong they were to doubt us.

entries.zh: §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!正在努力工作以兑现[Owner.Ruler.GetHisHer]的允诺。
我们必须履行承诺。[owner.GetName]子民们指望我们在未来40年内进入太空帝国的阶段。我们必须努力通过§G控制恒星系§!、§G殖民行星§!来扩张国家，如果遇到其他帝国则还需要§G签订防御条约§!。\n\n§G40年§!之后，我们每取得§G15点进度§!，我们的统治者§H$leader_trait_legendary_leader$特质§!就会得到进一步强化。
entries.en: We must deliver on our promises. [owner.GetName] citizens are counting on us to grow into a spacefaring empire in the coming 40 years. We should strive to expand our nation by §Gcontrolling systems§!, §Gcolonizing planets§!, and - if we encounter other empires - §Gsigning defense pacts§!.\n\nAfter §G40 years§!, our Ruler's §H$leader_trait_legendary_leader$ Trait§! will improve for every §G15 points§! of progress we've made.

entries.zh: 40年计划是我们帝国制胜的关键。在光耀者的指导下我们劲往一处使，就会取得远比我们单独行动更伟大的成就。
entries.en: The 40-year plan is vital to our empire's success. By combining our efforts under the Luminary's guidance, we will achieve things far greater than we could alone.

entries.zh: 增加§Y统一承诺§!局势的解决方案。\n给予一个随机的光耀者洞见效果。\n在§Y统一承诺§!局势生效期间基于思潮的议程获得一个光耀者洞见效果。
entries.en: Adds Approaches to the §YUnifying Promise§! Situation.\nGives one random Luminary Insight effect.\nEthic-based Agendas gain a Luminary Insight effect for the duration of the §YUnifing Promise§! Situation.

entries.zh:
新的殖民地是履行§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§!允诺的第一步。

殖民船被永久地转化成了新定居点的行政中心。我们正如火如荼地将其反应堆核心连接进电网，为殖民地发展提供能源。

随着无数的殖民者从船上登陆，围绕着殖民船巨大的船体，各种简易搭盖的住所和棚户如雨后春笋般出现。以这些建筑作为基础，有朝一日此地将会成为[Root.GetName]上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]城市。
entries.en:
This new colony is the first step towards fulfilling the §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§!'s promise.

The colony ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement. Work has begun to connect its reactor core to the power grid to supply the growing colony with energy.

As colonists disembark in large numbers, makeshift dwellings and shelters have been erected around the former starship's massive hull. These will form the basis of what will one day be the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on [Root.GetName].

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

在接下来的信息中，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]告诉[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]应当放下旧的疑虑，展望未来。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap]指出了我们共同取得的伟大成就，并指出让我们的过去错误阻碍我们前进是极其不合理的。如果[Root.Owner.GetName]能够团结一致，就没有什么是我们无法克服的！

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

In the message that follows, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] tells the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to cast aside old doubts and look to the future. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap] points to the great things we have achieved together, and to the irrationality in allowing our past mistakes to hold us back from progress. If the [Root.Owner.GetName] stand together as one, there is nothing we cannot overcome!

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh: §L尽管人们还是支持§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§!，我们事实上并没有完成我们的允诺，这会威胁到我们的政府。§!
entries.en: §LAlthough people still support §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§!, we did not in fact fulfill our promise and this undermines our government.§!

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

在接下来的信息中，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]在[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]面前赞扬了某些特定个人的成就——包括[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]自己的成就。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap]接着列举了我们共同取得的伟大成功，从一次光荣的成功到下一次，构筑起一个更加美好的未来。

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

In the message that follows, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] regales the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] with praise and stories on select individuals' accomplishments - including [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] own. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap] goes on to list what we have achieved together, one glorious success after the other, building up to a promise of an even greater future.

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh: §L我们已经完成了对公民许下的每一项承诺和愿景。§!
entries.en: §LWe delivered on every promise and expectation of our citizens.§!

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上新建的城市是一道靓丽的风景线。凭借奋斗与决心，殖民者成功地在新星球发展兴旺。\n\n[Root.GetName]上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]决定建造一座纪念§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的纪念碑以彰显忠诚。
entries.en: The new cities built on [Root.GetName] are a sight to behold. Through grit and determination, the colonists have managed to thrive on a new world.\n\n[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] citizens on [Root.GetName] decided to show their loyalty by erecting a monument to honor §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上的居民会建设一座献给§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§!的纪念碑。
entries.en: The inhabitants of [Root.GetName] will build a monument dedicated to their §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§!.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!将以个人名义帮助建设流程。
entries.en: §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! will personally help with the construction process.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上的居民会用筹集到的资金来进行另一项计划。
entries.en: Inhabitants of [Root.GetName] will use the gathered funds to pursue another project.

entries.zh: §H[Root.Owner.GetName]每一块国有的屏幕被打断了播放安排，开始广播一段来自[Root.GetName]的官方公告。§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!站立在一座未揭幕的纪念碑前。§!\n\n今日，我们创造了历史，我们的物种过去从未达成过此般成就。在我的带领和你们辛勤的工作下，没有任何事物可以阻挡我们！[Root.GetName]上的殖民者想赞扬我，但今天，我想感谢你们每一位的辛勤劳动。[Root.Owner.GetName]万岁！
entries.en: §HEvery state-owned screen in the [Root.Owner.GetName] interrupts its scheduled stream to broadcast an official communication from [Root.GetName]. §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! stands in front of a veiled monument.§!\n\nToday, we have made history. Never before has our species realized a grander achievement. With my guidance, with your hard work, no obstacle shall stand in our way! The colonists of [Root.GetName] wished to honor me, and I thank them. Glory to the [Root.Owner.GetName]!

entries.zh: §H随着这座§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的纪念碑揭幕，人群中爆发出了欢呼和掌声。§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§!自豪地伫立着，眺望着地平线，以及我们那光辉的未来。这是我们第一次征服了一颗新的星球！§!
entries.en: §HThe crowd erupts in cheers as the monument of §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! is unveiled. §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§! stands proudly, looking towards the horizon and the glorious future that awaits us. For the first time, we have conquered a new world!§!

entries.zh: §H[Root.Owner.GetName]每一块国有的屏幕突然中断了正常的播放，然后开始广播一段来自[Root.GetName]的官方公告。画面中，§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!站立在一座未揭幕的纪念碑前。§!\n\n今日，我们创造了历史，我们的物种过去从未达成过此般成就。在我的带领和你们辛勤的工作下，没有任何事物可以阻挡我们！[Root.GetName]上的居民想以此赞扬我，但今天，我们应为在一起奋斗过感到光荣，让我们携手步入成功！
entries.en: §HEvery state-owned screen in the [Root.Owner.GetName] interrupts its scheduled stream to broadcast an official communication from [Root.GetName]. §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! stands in front of a veiled monument.§!\n\nToday, we have made history. Never before has our species realized a grander achievement. With my guidance, with your hard work, no obstacle shall stand in our way! The colonists of [Root.GetName] wanted to honor me, but today, all are honored equally. United we triumph!

entries.zh: §H随着这座以§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!被其他[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]英烈环绕着为主旨的纪念碑揭幕，人群中爆发出了欢呼和掌声。他们团结地矗立着，一个国家凝聚在了一个共同的目标上。§!
entries.en: §HThe crowd erupts in cheers as the monument of §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!, flanked by the heroic frames of other [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] is unveiled. They stand united, a nation focused on a common goal.§!

entries.zh: §H[Root.Owner.GetName]每一块国有的屏幕突然中断了正常的播放，然后开始广播一段来自[Root.GetName]的官方公告。画面中，§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!站立在一座未揭幕的纪念碑前。§!\n\n今日，我们创造了历史，我们的物种过去从未达成过此般成就。在我的带领和你们辛勤的工作下，没有任何事物可以阻挡我们！[Root.GetName]上的居民想以此赞扬我，但他们才是我们人民真正的英雄。我只不过是一介人民公仆，有了你们，我们才能迈入光明的未来。
entries.en: §HEvery state-owned screen in the [Root.Owner.GetName] interrupts its scheduled stream to broadcast an official communication from [Root.GetName]. §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! stands in front of a veiled monument.§!\n\nToday, we have made history. Never before has our species realized a grander achievement. The people of [Root.GetName] wanted to honor me today, but they are the real heroes of our people. I am but a servant of our nation. Thanks to you, we take another step towards a brighter future!

entries.zh: 这就是我拒绝让这些自豪的殖民者以我的名义建造一座纪念碑的原因。相反，这些资金将被用在城市建设上。繁荣在等待我们！\n\n$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en: This is why I refused to have these proud colonists build a monument in my name. Instead, the funds are to be used for city building. Prosperity awaits!\n\n$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh: 内阁已经不堪重负。\n\n尽管§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的能量似乎无穷无尽，但治理一个星际帝国的工作量已使内阁成员们超负荷工作。尽管如此，仍然有一些问题尚未解决，有必要将一部分担子分出去，让其他人处理。
entries.en: The council is overwhelmed.\n\nWhile §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!'s energy seems unlimited, the councilors are overworked by the demands of a galactic empire. Issues have been left unresolved, and it will be necessary to pick up some of the slack.

entries.zh: 我们收到了许多关于海盗袭扰我们贸易路线的报道。内阁正在请求军事支援来应对这些威胁。
entries.en: We have received multiple reports of pirates plaguing our trade routes. The council has asked for military support to deal with this menace.

entries.zh: 一些殖民者和深空研究团队对我们的通讯系统颇有微词，他们已经有好几天收不到消息了。工程师建议在首都建造一座通讯中继器来增强信号。
entries.en: Some colonists and deep space research teams are criticizing our communication systems - there are days when they can't get any message through. Engineers suggest building a communication relay in our capital system to boost the signal.

entries.zh: 信号增强器已经激活。初步测试证明，它足以确保在我们的太空中进行稳定通信。\n\n现在看来，之前的干扰是有意为之的破坏行为。虽然破坏者的身份仍未知晓，但新系统应该能够保护我们免受任何进一步的干扰。
entries.en: The signal booster has been activated. The first tests prove that it should be enough to ensure stable communication across our space.\n\nIt now appears that the previous disruptions were caused by intentional acts of sabotage. While the perpetrators remain unknown, the new system should protect us against any further disruption.

entries.zh: 我们夺回了自己的声音。
深空工人正在罢工，抗议严峻的工作环境。他们要求增加休息时间并提升工作安全管理。作为回应，我们提议给予他们数天全休日，并在首都星球举行一场盛大游行，重新点燃他们的民族自豪感。
entries.en: Deep-space workers are striking in protest against harsh conditions. They demand more free time and increased safety regulations. In response, we have proposed a slate of work-free days and a grand parade on our capital world to reignite a sense of national pride.

entries.zh: 游行进行得比我们的预想好得多！公民们为§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!欢呼喝彩的画面被拍下来，并在[Owner.GetName]范围内广为流传，以对恩慈的[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]表示尊敬。不过，在首都还是爆发过一些小规模的骚乱，但秩序很快就恢复了，没有伤亡发生。媒体也因安保单位的快速反应而对§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!大加赞扬。
entries.en: The parade went better than expected! Images of citizens cheering for §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! were recorded and published across [Owner.GetName] to show support for the benevolent [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]. While a number of small riots were reported across the capital, order was swiftly restored. There were no casualties, and state media praised §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! for the swift response of our security forces.

entries.zh: 我们收到了一些关于基层军官诋毁§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!名声的报告。这样的行径绝不能逃避惩罚。那些相关者，最少最少，也应该被开除军籍。
entries.en: There have been reports of low-ranking military officers actively smearing the name of §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!. This cannot go unpunished. Those responsible should, at the very least, be discharged from the service.

entries.zh: 这些谋反的异见军官被逮捕了。庆幸的是，他们的人数很少，但这次事件表明，即使是我们的军队也可能被叛徒渗透。我们抓住了主要的煽动者，但我们不应该排除与非军事组织的联系。
entries.en: The dissident officers who were conspiring against us have been arrested. Thankfully, they were few in numbers, but this incident indicates that even our military can be infiltrated by traitors. We were able to catch the main instigators, but we shouldn't rule out possible ties to non-military groups.

entries.zh: 内阁最近受到了严格审查。匿名投诉反映，数目惊人的重要职位被高官的亲朋好友占据。我们已答应调查此事，并改弦易辙。
entries.en: The council has recently come under heavy scrutiny. Anonymous complaints highlight the staggering amount of important positions which have been filled by the friends and family of high-ranking officials. We have promised to look into the matter and to do better.
We need to clean up our ranks.

entries.zh: 特别委员会对内阁高层进行了彻底的巡查。发现了许多资质不足的人，绝大多数人被解除职务。其中一小部分有前途的人才被送去参加培训。
entries.en: A special committee has scoured the higher echelons of the council. Many unqualified individuals were identified, and most have already been dismissed from their posts. A few of the more promising talents were sent to training sessions.

entries.zh: 在首都恒星系建造一座通讯中继站以避免长距离通讯受到干扰。我们最好的工程师已经准备好开展工作了。
entries.en: Building a relay in our capital system will prevent disruptions in long-range communications. Our best engineers are ready to get to work.

entries.zh: 准备一场盛大的游行，设立公休假日，这需要大量的准备工作。如果我们要重燃国家自豪感，一切都必须安排得尽善尽美。
entries.en: A grand parade and public holiday will require a great deal of preparation. Everything must be perfect if we are to rekindle the nation's pride.

entries.zh: 异见者正悄悄地在我们的军队里落地生根，他们诽谤§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!并试图谋反。我们必须采取快速而强有力的行动。
entries.en: Dissidents are taking root inside our military, slandering §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! and scheming against us. Swift and decisive action must be taken.

entries.zh: 制止内阁中的裙带关系应该是我们的首要任务，因为它几乎阻碍了我们所做的一切。清理这些腐败可能需要一些时间，但我们的人民对我们抱有期待。
entries.en: Putting a stop to nepotism in the council should be our top priority, as it hinders almost everything we do. It may take some time to clean up all this corruption, but our people are counting on us.

entries.zh: 尽管§Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!已经倍加努力，但仍有许多事务有待完成。整个帝国是由许多互相矛盾的派系组成，人们是在[owner.Ruler.GetTitle]不断的努力下才团结起来。\n\n尽管§Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!未曾想过要改革大一统后形成的政府，但一种新的、更直接的体制可以解决其中一些问题。另一方面，这样的决定可能会激起反对意见。
entries.en: Despite §Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!'s work, there is still much to be done. The empire consists of conflicting factions, and the population is united only through the constant effort of the [owner.Ruler.GetTitle].\n\nAlthough §Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! did not wish to change the post-Unification government, a new, more direct approach could remedy some of these problems. On the other hand, such a decision may encounter significant opposition.

entries.zh: §L只有授予[owner.Ruler.GetTitle]无限的权力，我们才有可能统治繁星。从现在起，[owner.Ruler.GetTitle]对内阁拥有绝对的权威。愿[owner.Ruler.GetHisHer]的统治长久而繁荣！§!\n这将强化§T[owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的统治，但可能在未来造成§R严重的后果§!。
entries.en: §LOnly by granting unlimited power to the [owner.Ruler.GetTitle], can we hope to rule the stars. From now on, the [owner.Ruler.GetTitle] will have absolute authority over the council. May [owner.Ruler.GetHisHer] rule be long and fruitful!§!\nThis will strengthen §T[owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!'s rule, but might have §Rdire consquences§! in the future.

entries.zh: §L我们的人民深信[owner.Ruler.GetTitle]将引领大家前往繁星，但从未同意创造一个世袭头衔或施行帝制。用这样的方式攫取权力是暴政。§!维持现状才能稳定国家。
entries.en: §LOur people entrusted the [owner.Ruler.GetTitle] to guide them to the stars, but they never agreed to a royal title or imperial rule. Seizing power like this would be tyranny.§! Holding the status quo should stabilize the nation.

entries.zh: 消息如野火般蔓延开。几位官员签署同意之后，一场盛大的登基仪式在全国范围内进行播报。大多数[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都为§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!能够完全地掌握国家而感到欢欣鼓舞。\n\n在这一片欢腾的场景之下，掩藏着不可明说的问题和各类不确定情况。新的帝国将会是什么样的呢？
entries.en: The news spread like wildfire. A few official signatures later, and a grand coronation ceremony was broadcast to the nation. The majority of [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are happy that §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! will now have full control of state.\n\nWhile the mood is festive, unspoken questions and uncertainties remain. What will this new empire look like?
The military must play a central role.

entries.zh: 法律与秩序是至高无上的。

entries.en: Our nation is open to all.

entries.zh: 和平将为我们带来繁荣。
entries.en: Peace will bring us wealth and prosperity.
Progress will lead us to greatness.

entries.zh: 帝国将会成抵御外星威胁的铜墙铁壁。
entries.en: The Empire will be a shield against the xeno threat.

entries.zh: §H现在是§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!昭告[Ruler.GetHerHis]臣民的时候了。国有媒体正在广播[Ruler.GetHerHis]发言。§!\n\n[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]同胞们！当我们处于危难年代时，你们寻求了我的指引。我向你们保证，你们对我的信任将会获得很好的回报。赋予我权力的同时也意味着伟大的责任，我发誓忠实地为这个国家和我的臣民服务。我作为皇帝的第一项法案是建立一个学府，在那里最优秀、最聪明的人将接受培训，建立一个我们都能为之自豪的未来。向繁星进军，向胜利进军！
entries.en: §HIt is time for §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! to address [Ruler.GetHerHis] loyal subjects. The state-owned media are broadcasting [Ruler.GetHerHis] speech.§!\n\nFellow [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! You have looked to me for guidance in our time of need, and I promise you that your trust will be well rewarded. The power bestowed upon me come with great responsibility, and I swear to faithfully serve this nation and you, my subjects. My first act as emperor is the establishment of a seat of learning where the best and brightest will be trained to build a future we can all be proud of. To the stars, and victory!

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]的讯息强调了今天是一个光荣的日子！这个联邦的建立确实是一件值得庆祝的事情。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap]谈到了我们与盟国们构筑的纽带，阐明同[your_ally.GetName]的合使两国迈入全新的时代。一个充满伟大和繁荣的黄金时代！

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]'s message highlights what a glorious day this is! The founding of this Federation is truly a cause for celebration. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap] speaks to bonds we forge with our allies, stating that cooperation with the [your_ally.GetName] will usher in a new age. A golden age of greatness and prosperity!

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

宣言的重点放在了[your_ally.GetName]，该国承认了我们的优越性，服从我们的统治和指导！该国的明智和信任将得到应有的回报，我们希望其他国家也能做出正确的选择，向我国臣服。

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

The announcement is focused on the [your_ally.GetName], who have recognized our superiority and submitted to our rule and guidance! Their wisdom and trust will be duly rewarded, and we hope that other nations will also make the right choice and submit.

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

前方传来签署和平条约的新闻，同时人们又听说我们的敌人被迫接受巨大的让步，因此欢欣鼓舞。我们见证了在光耀者的指引下获得的胜利！

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

The people rejoice as news arrives of a signed peace treaty and the vast concessions our foes were forced to accept. We stand witness to the triumpth of Luminary guidance!

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

今天对于[Owner.GetName]来说是一个悲惨的日子。侵略者的残忍行径在新闻推送中得到了充分的展示，[Ruler.GetName]强调在这个黑暗时期团结一致是尤其必要的。§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!郑重承诺，确保实现可能的最好结果，同时此类事情不再发生。

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Today is a grim day for the [Owner.GetName]. The brutality of the invaders is on full display in the news feed, as [Ruler.GetName] underlines the necessity of working together during these dark times. §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! makes a solemn vow to ensure the best possible outcome, and to never let this happen again.

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]保持沉默。新闻中显示[Owner.GetName]签署了附庸条约。尽管我们始终相信光耀者的统治，但是这一刻无疑是我们文明一个不可避免的挫折。

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] is silent. The newsfeed shows the signing of [Owner.GetName]'s contract of vassalization. Despite our trust in the Luminary's rule, this moment signifies an undeniable setback for our civilization.

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

今天是一个命运攸关的日子。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]自豪地宣布，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]带来了一个消息：星海共同体已经选举我们成为至高无上的星海监管人。他们承认只有我们才有能力确保这个星系的安全。我们被赋予了巨大的权力，我们的职责不仅仅是履行各国的期许，更是要将其超越。

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Today is a fateful day. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] stands proudly as [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] the news is delivered: the Galactic Community has elected us to supreme Custodianship. They have recognized that we alone are poised to ensure the safety of this galaxy. We have been granted great power, and it is our duty to not only meet, but surpass all expectations.

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

今天是我们胜利的日子！星海参议院任命[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]为星海帝国的皇帝。为了表示敬意，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]发誓要把已知的星系及其人民带入一个新的繁荣时代——从现在开始，直到永远！

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Today is the day of our triumph! The Galactic Senate has appointed [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] Emperor of the Galactic Imperium. In salute, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] swears to usher the known galaxy and its peoples into a new age of prosperity - from now, and to eternity!

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh: 我们的意识形态反对者已经形成了一个强大的政治集团。他们呼吁他们的支持者聚集在一起，和平抗议他们认为由§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!所颁布的单边变革！\n\n他们认为，我们已经偏离了大一统后设立下的路线，并呼吁§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!废除某些改革。
entries.en: Our ideological opponents have formed a powerful political block. They have called upon their supporters to gather in peaceful protest against what they see as unilateral changes enacted by §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!\n\nThey argue that we have strayed from the path set after the Unification, and call upon §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! to repeal certain reforms.

entries.zh: 抗议者聚集到政府大楼门口，要求§Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!听听他们的诉苦。这些人中间绝大多是人是年轻人，但是他们的领袖却是大统一战争中的老兵。忽略他们的需求可能是不明智的。
entries.en: Protesters are gathering in front of governmental buildings demanding that §Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! hear out their grievances. Most of them are youngsters, but among their leaders are veterans of the Unification. Ignoring their demands may prove unwise.

entries.zh: 抗议者们不是铁板一块，每天都有新的派系产生。我们正在努力找出他们的领袖。
entries.en: The protests are not a coordinated effort, and new groups spring up almost daily. We are working hard to identify their leaders.

entries.zh: 我们可以利用宣传来破坏反对派的支持。这可能会迷惑民众，但应该让我们来维持和平。
entries.en: We can use propaganda to undermine the opposition's support. This could confuse the population, but should let us maintain the peace.

entries.zh: 通过倾听和与反对派中更理性的群体交谈，我们可以一边安抚媒体，一边对付那些更加……极端的成员。
entries.en: By listening and talking to the more reasonable groups in the opposition, we can appease the media while we deal with the more... extreme elements.

entries.zh: 我们绝不容忍意见分子。对那些想要破坏我们的人必须重拳出击。
entries.en: We cannot tolerate dissidence. We must crush those who would undermine us.

entries.zh: 一群自称“被遗忘者”的地下团体控诉§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的暴政。他们宣称我国政府从未真正代表人民的意愿，反而只是代表一小撮特定的群体利益。他们并不相信[Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]，并提供了曾经的不同政见者已经失踪的证据。他们这些反复发出的讯息开始在我们的公民群体中埋下怀疑的种子。
entries.en: A secretive group calling themselves The Forgotten has accused §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! of tyranny. They claim that our government no longer represents the will of our people, only the interests of a select few. Their trust in [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has waned, and they have brought forward evidence of dissenters who have suddenly disappeared after criticizing our regime. Their repeated messages are starting to sow doubt in the minds of our citizens.

entries.zh: 在研究了所谓证据后，似乎§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!确实是向那些被遗忘者们撒谎了，至少也是隐瞒了真相。[Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe]与数个强大的利益派系签订了几份协议，在其中许诺了诸多[Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe]实际上做不到的事情。\n\n今天，被遗忘者代表那些被[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]所欺骗之人的声音，向我们呼吁将政府权力转移至议会及人民手中。
entries.en: After reviewing the evidence, it appears that §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! has indeed lied or at least concealed the truth to the council and the population at large. [Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe] has signed several contracts with various powerful stakeholders, promising many things that [Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe] could not realistically deliver upon.\n\nToday, the Forgotten have made themselves the voice of all those who have been tricked by the [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] and are calling upon our government to transfer power back to the council and the people.

entries.zh: 一些能够抹黑§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!秘密文件从一个匿名团体处流出。这一叛国行径为这场政治风波火上浇油。被遗忘者最有动机，但却表现得很无辜，因为我们完全找不到他们涉及此事的证据。
entries.en: In an attempt to smear §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!'s reputation, secret documents have been leaked by an anonymous party. This treasonous act has poured oil onto the political fires that were already threatening to consume our government. The Forgotten, although prime suspects, appear innocent, as we could not find any proof of their involvement.

entries.zh: 政治局势已经失控。煽动者正在煽风点火，而§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的拒绝让步引发了帝国范围内的暴力抗议浪潮。随着伤亡人数的增多，§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§!别无选择，只能下令要求以一切必要手段镇压反对派。
entries.en: The political situation has escalated out of control. As agitators fan the flames of revolution, §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s§! refusal to back down has ignited an empire wide wave of violent protests. The casualties are mounting, and left with no other choice, the §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]§! has ordered the opposition be crushed by any means necessary.

entries.zh: §L我们知道这些麻烦制造者住在哪里。我们可以把他们都逮捕关进监狱。§!
entries.en: §LWe know where these troublemakers live. We can round them up and lock them up.§!

entries.zh: §L通过拒绝低头妥协，我们将向所有的异见者们展示我们正在为人民的福祉而竭尽全力。§!
entries.en: §LBy refusing to stoop to their level, we will show all dissidents that we are doing everything we can for the good of the people.§!

entries.zh: §L异见者是对国家的威胁，必须清理掉。§!
entries.en: §LDissidents are a threat to the nation that must be eliminated.§!

entries.zh: 在极大的压力下，§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!已经发展出了一种独特的应对压力的方法。尽管有些人可能认为这只是一个怪癖，但它影响着整个内阁。
entries.en: Under intense pressure, §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! has developed a unique way to cope with stress. Although some might see this as a simple quirk, it affects the whole council.
We'll learn to live with it.

entries.zh: §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!通过孜孜不倦地学习以成为一名更好的领袖。[Owner.Ruler.GetHisHerCap]焕然一新的献身做派让内阁瞩目。
entries.en: §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! has worked extremely hard to become a better leader. [Owner.Ruler.GetHisHerCap] renewed commitment has already been noticed by the council.

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

社会正在螺旋坠入失控境地。猖獗的暴力、隐秘的煽动、无耻的谎言……这些问题困扰我们已久。我自豪地宣布，这些困难时期已经结束！那些试图破坏我们的人已被逮捕，我保证，他们将面临全面的法律制裁。不久之后，他们将为对你们造成的伤害而忏悔！

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Society is spiralling out of control. Rampant violence, insidious agitation, shameless lies... These things have plagued us for too long. With great pride, I announce an end to these troubled times! Those who sought to undermine us have been arrested, and I promise, they will face the full force of justice. Before long, they will repent for the harm they caused you!

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

在冲突时期，我们很容易忘记为之奋斗的目标，把我们的政治对手视为彻头彻尾的敌人。我们经历了艰难的时刻，但今天我很自豪地告诉你们，我们已经达成了和平的结果。你们的声音已经被听到了。你们曾经信任过我，而我却让你们失望了。

这样的情况到此为止！随着即将到来的宪法改革，我坚信我们已经回到了正确的道路上。出于你们对我能力的信任，我将谦卑地见证这些变革的落实。我发誓，我不会再让你们失望！

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

In times of conflict, it can be easy to lose sight of what we fight for, to view our political opponents as outright enemies. We have gone through trying times, but today I am proud to tell you that we have reached a peaceful outcome. Your voices have been heard. You had put your trust in me and I had failed you.

No more! With the upcoming constitutional reform, I firmly believe that we find ourselves back on the right path, and I am humbled by your trust in my ability to see these changes through. Upon my word, I shall not fail you again!

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

今天是伟大的胜利之日，但这并非没有牺牲的代价。我们的敌人已经被消灭，但是他们的背叛使我的心处于巨大的伤痛之中。他们出于自私的目的，试图毁灭我们所有人，但最终，他们无法匹敌我们团结一致产生的力量。很快，他们将因自己的罪行受处决。我们取得了胜利！

$paragon.ending.speech$
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Today marks a great victory, but it has not been bought without sacrifice. Our enemies have been destroyed, yet the sting of their betrayal makes my heart bleed. In their selfishness they sought to destroy us all, but in the end, they were no match for our collective strength. Soon they will be executed for their crimes. We have prevailed!

$paragon.ending.speech$

entries.zh: 我们需要一位更强大的领袖！
§L最近的事件表明，只有§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的英明领导可以为我们社会带来和平和繁荣。我们需要将更多的权力巩固到我们的领袖手中。§!
entries.en: §LRecent events have shown that only the wise rule of §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! can bring peace and prosperity to our society. We need to consolidate more power into the hands of our leader.§!

entries.zh: §L最近的事件表明，为了在未来克服这些困境，我们必须要有一个强大政府的领导。我们需要将更多权力移交给内阁。\n§!$paragon.leader.growth.negative$
entries.en: §LRecent events have shown that a strong government rule is needed to overcome such dilemmas in the future. We need to give more power to the council.\n§!$paragon.leader.growth.negative$

entries.zh: §Y[Owner.GetHeirTitle][Owner.GetHeirName]§!去世了。我们尚未确定死因，但初步调查显示这是自然死亡。[Ruler.GetRegnalName]深受[Ruler.GetHisHer]子嗣之丧的打击。官方法令宣布了全国哀悼期，同时我们等待对继承人死因的调查结果。
entries.en: §Y[Owner.GetHeirTitle] [Owner.GetHeirName]§! is dead. We have yet to determine the cause of death, but preliminary reports suggest natural causes. [Ruler.GetRegnalName] was struck hard by the loss of [Ruler.GetHisHer] progeny. A period of national mourning has been decreed and we await the full results of the investigation into the cause of the heir's death.

entries.zh: 尽管所有的证据都表明这是一次自然死亡，§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!却拒绝接受这个事实。[Ruler.GetHisHer]的继承人之死对[Ruler.GetHimHer]产生了很大影响，并下令在我们的领土范围内展开搜捕行动。必须要找到那些为此负责的懦弱的刺杀者。安全部队已经开展行动，根除异见分子。\n\n这些逮捕行动所伴随的暴力程度已经震惊了许多公民。抗议活动再次爆发，谴责滥用权力并要求新一轮政府改革。一个行星的绝大多数人口起来反对[Ruler.GetTitle]的统治，这在我们的历史上属于首次。
entries.en: Despite every evidence pointing at a natural death, §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! refused to accept it. The death of [Ruler.GetHisHer] heir has greatly affected [Ruler.GetHimHer], and orders have been sent across our territories. Those responsible for this cowardly assassination must be found. Security forces are already conducting sweeps to root out dissenters.\n\nThe level of violence that has accompanied these arrests has shocked many of our citizens. Protests denouncing the abuses of power and demanding a new wave of government reforms have erupted once again. For the first time in our history, the majority of a planet's population has risen up against the rule of the [Ruler.GetTitle].

entries.zh: §Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!死后，改革派的支持率逐渐降低了。该团体的代表抛开意识形态上的分歧，特意参加了葬礼仪式。虽然今天被悲伤的气氛所笼罩，但也是一个令人团结一心的时刻——提醒[Root.Owner.GetName]所代表的意义。
entries.en: After §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s§! death, support for the Reformists dwindled. Putting aside their ideological differences, representatives from the group made a point of attending the funeral ceremony. Although today is marred by sorrow, it is also a moment of unity - a reminder of what the [Root.Owner.GetName] stands for.

entries.zh: 无论是我们对资源的巧妙利用还是引入了强有力的惩罚措施，叛乱的星球不再是一个问题。我们再次团结起来，民众专注于发展而不是内讧。§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!颁布法令，将今天定为一个特殊的纪念日。
entries.en: Whether due to our clever use of resources or the introduction of robust punishments, rebellious planets are no longer an issue. Once again we stand united, with the populace focused on growth rather than infighting. §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! has decreed today will be a special commemorative holiday going forward.

entries.zh: 改革派的煽动者打着自由的幌子试图摧毁我们的国家！随着暴力冲突在我们的领土上爆发，他们的谎言已经说服了许多人民转而反对我们。他们认为§Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!软弱、残忍、无能，但我们会向他们证明不是这样的！
entries.en: Under the guise of freedom, the Reformists demagogues are trying to destroy the nation! As violent clashes erupt across our territories, their lies have convinced many of our people to turn on us. They think §Y[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! weak, cruel and incompetent, but we will show them!

entries.zh: 对所有已知的改革派藏身处进行暴力打击，应该可以恢复国家的稳定。\n为了终结当下的局势，完成§Y$council_agenda_origin_delusional_tyrant_name$§!议程。
entries.en: A brutal crackdown on all known Reformist hideouts ought to restore stability to the nation.\nTo put an end to the situation, finish the §Y$council_agenda_origin_delusional_tyrant_name$§! Agenda.

entries.zh: 对平民发动攻击是不可接受的。我们将以和平方式推进，呼吁停火并邀请改革派进行谈判。希望这样可以减少暴力行为的需求。
entries.en: Fighting against civilians is unacceptable. We will push forward peacefully, calling for a truce and inviting the Reformists to negotiate. Hopefully, this will limit the need for violence.

entries.zh: 改革派绝不会同暴君进行谈判。
entries.en: The Reformists will never agree to negotiate with a tyrant.

entries.zh: 改革派正在压垮我们防护薄弱的前哨，保皇派部队正在竭尽全力将他们拒之门外。
entries.en: Reformists are overwhelming our less protected outposts, and loyalist forces are struggling to keep them at bay.

entries.zh: 改革派开始在一些冲突中占据上风，但我们仍然牢牢控制着权力。
entries.en: Reformists are starting to get the upper hand in some clashes, but power remains firmly in our hands.

entries.zh: 我们对反叛的改革派有一点优势，但力量的天平有可能向任何一边倾斜。
entries.en: We have a slight advantage over the rebellious Reformists, but the balance of power could swing either way.

entries.zh: 改革派叛军正在持续骚扰忠诚的安保部队。
entries.en: Reformist militias are constantly harassing loyal security forces.

entries.zh: 无论通过何种方式，这场冲突必须中止。我们现在的决定会影响到未来开展谈判所达成的结果。
entries.en: One way or another, this conflict must end. Our decisions now will affect the way in which any future negotiations unfold.

entries.zh: 民主主义是必须要治疗的病痛。我们的安保部队将突袭所有改革派的藏身处。平民伤亡在所难免。
entries.en: Democracy is an ailment that needs to be remedied. Our security officers will raid Reformist hideouts and put an end to their schemes. Civilian casualties are to be expected.

entries.zh: 这将会移除§Y改革派诉求§!局势的§G4§!点进度。\n如果行星上没有平等主义的人口，有50%几率移除该行星的§Y民主倾向§!修正。\n这将会使§Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]的§!§Y光耀者特质§!§R劣化§!。
entries.en: This will remove §G4§! Progress from the §YReformists Demands§! Situation.\nThere is a 50% chance to remove §YDemocratic Tendencies§! modifier from the planet if no Egalitarian Pops are present.\nThis will §Rworsen§! §Y[owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s§! §YLuminary Trait§!.

entries.zh: 通过在全国范围内逮捕他们的领袖，我们可以削弱改革派的力量，迫使他们按照我们的条件进行谈判。
entries.en: By apprehending their leaders in an empire-wide sweep, we can cripple the Reformists and force them to the negotiating table on our terms.

entries.zh: 通过逮捕改革派领袖来结束§Y改革派的要求§!局势
entries.en: Conclude §YReformists Demands§! Situation by apprehending Reformist leaders.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!发现我们的一位领袖正在反对政府！妥善的程序是直接处死这名叛徒，但是证据不是很充分。
entries.en: §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! has discovered that one of our leaders is plotting against the government! The proper course would be to execute the traitor, but evidence is scarce.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!下令在我们的一颗行星上进行大范围的清洗行动。显然，那里存在一个改革派据点，但我们尚未掌握充分证据。我们确定要因为预感将忠诚公民的性命置于危险之中吗？
entries.en: §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! ordered a large scale cleansing on one of our planets. Apparently, there is a supposed Reformist holdout there, but no firm evidence has been produced. Will we really risk the lives of loyal citizens on a hunch?

entries.zh: 改革派的一个小团体加入了当地的海盗组织。虽然他们不是一个严重的威胁，但他们仍然可以扰乱我们在该星域的运营和贸易。
entries.en: One of the alleged Reformist cells joined forces with a local group of pirates. Although they are not a serious threat, they can still disrupt our operations and trade in the sector.

entries.zh: 来自[event_target:friendly_nation]的一位显赫公民希望在我们的内部斗争中帮助我们。他们不仅带来了美好愿景，同时还伴随着一批合金作为援助。似乎他们寻求改善我们之间的关系，但§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!怀疑这是为异己分子的运动建立供应线的诡计。
entries.en: A prominent citizen from [event_target:friendly_nation] wishes to help us in our internal struggle. Their best wishes were accompanied by a shipment of alloys to aid us. It seems they seek to improve relations between us, but §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! suspects a ruse to establish supply lines for the dissident movements.

entries.zh: 我们的安全部门成功追踪并捣毁了一个改革派窝点。这次行动取得了极大的成功，人员损失降到最低，没有平民伤亡。
entries.en: Our security service managed to hunt down and dismantle one of the Reformists' cells. The operation was a clear success, with minimal loss of life and no civilian casualties.

entries.zh: 我们的安全部门成功地追踪到了一个改革派窝点，但他们在整个街区都埋设了爆炸物。当我们的特工突入窝点的时候，他们引爆了炸药，杀死了许多人。
entries.en: Our security service managed to track down a Reformist cell, but they had rigged the whole block with explosives. As our operatives breached the lair, they activated the charges, killing many.

entries.zh: 我们和改革派发生了激烈的交火，有很多平民受伤。我们派出了应急部队来照料伤者。
entries.en: Many civilians were hurt in a series of fierce firefights between our forces and the Reformists. We have sent emergency responders to take care of the wounded.

entries.zh: 我们忠诚的支持者举行了一场集会，声援§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!！我们在这场斗争中显然赢得了人民的支持！
entries.en: Our loyal supporters made a rally to back up §Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!! We clearly have the support of the people in our fight!

entries.zh: 改革派的宣传部门在我们的某颗行星上发起了一场虚假信息运动。忠诚派势力正在保持高度警戒，意图控制局面，但抗议者的队伍继续壮大。
entries.en: Reformist propagandists led a disinformation campaign on one of our planets. Loyalist forces are on their toes to keep the situation under control, but the protesters continue to grow in strength.

entries.zh: 由于内阁的努力工作，改革派领袖已被迅速逮捕。他们现在听由§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!发落。但另一方面，他们在民众中拥有许多支持者，所以明智的做法是通过谈判达成一个的双方都有利的结果——当然条件是我们说的算。
entries.en: Thanks to the Council's hard work, the Reformist leaders have been swiftly apprehended. They are now at the mercy of §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!, but they have many supporters among the populace, and it is advisable to negotiate an outcome that suits both parties - albeit on our terms.

entries.zh: 让我们听听他们的条件。
经过几个月的冲突，现在是时候让我们解决分歧，讨论如何结束这场荒谬的叛乱了。§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!已呼吁停火并与改革派进行谈判。所有敌对行动已经停止，每个人都在等待谈判结果的出现。
entries.en: After months of conflict, the time has come to resolve our differences and talk about how we can end this ridiculous revolt. §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! has called for a ceasefire to negotiate with the Reformists. All hostilities have ceased, as everyone awaits the outcome of the negotiations.

entries.zh:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]同胞！今天，我想让大家知道，我充满了自豪。我们求同存异，作为一个民族，向着未知一同进发，建造了新的星球，我们的聪明才智达到了新的高度。

我要感谢诸位的付出……

我还要……

§H§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!突然一个踉跄，消失在了画面之外。§!
entries.en:
$paragon.beginning.speech$

Fellow [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Today, I want you to know I am filled with pride. As a people, we have come together and, despite differences, ventured into the unknown, built new worlds, and reached new heights of ingenuity.

I want to acknowledge your sacrifice...

I want...

§H§Y[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! suddenly staggers out of view.§!

entries.zh: 新闻很快就传遍了全国上下：§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!正生命垂危。这场神秘的急病原因尚不明确，似乎也不会很快结束。\n\n至少目前，§Y[Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!仍名义上在位。然而，如果想要显著延长我们领袖的寿命，可能必须依靠一些非传统方法了。
entries.en: The news didn't take long to spread among the population; §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! is dying. While the cause of this mysterious illness remains unknown, it does not appear to be immediately terminal.\n\nFor now, §Y[Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! can remain at their post. However, unorthodox methods will be necessary to extend our leader's life by any significant amount of time.

entries.zh: 新闻很快就传遍了全国上下：§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的神经网络出故障了。这个神秘的故障让我们最聪明的人都摸不着头脑，似乎不会很快被排除。\n\n至少目前，§Y[Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!仍名义上在位。然而，如果想要显著延长我们领袖的工作周期，可能必须依靠一些非传统方法了。
entries.en: The news didn't take long to spread among the population; §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! neural net is failing. While the cause of this mysterious error has eluded our best minds, it is not immediately terminal.\n\nFor now, §Y[Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! can remain at their post. However, unorthodox methods will be necessary to repair and extend our leader's functionality by any significant amount of time.

entries.zh: 一定会有我们行得通的办法的。
entries.en: There must be something we can do.

entries.zh: §L我们会探索一切可能的方法来救活[Ruler.GetName]§!
entries.en: §LWe will explore every possible avenue to save [Ruler.GetName].§!

entries.zh: 是时候让§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!再度执掌国家的大舵了。[Ruler.GetName]受赐福继承了$leader_trait_legendary_leader$的品质，仍然充满着庄严。然而，随着改革派势力的增强，一场全面内战逐渐逼近，[Ruler.GetTitle]发出了谈判的号召。\n\n[Ruler.GetName]报告道，谈判前期气氛十分紧张。来自[Owner.GetName]各处的代表在听取我们[Ruler.GetTitle]的官方声明——其中列出了所有我们可能接受的让步——之前，纷纷提出了自己的要求。
entries.en: It is time for §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! to retake the helm of state. Blessed with the heritage of the $leader_trait_legendary_leader$, [Ruler.GetName] remains a magnetic figure. However, with the increasing power of the Reformists and a full-fledged civil war looming on the horizon, the [Ruler.GetTitle] issued a call to negotiations.\n\n[Ruler.GetName] reports that early negotiations have been tense. Representatives from all corners of [Owner.GetName] made their demands before listening to our [Ruler.GetTitle]'s official statement, which listed the concessions we might accept.
We will give them what they want.

entries.zh: 我们不会作出任何让步。
拥有§Y民主倾向§!修正的行星将会叛乱。
entries.en: Planets with §YDemocratic Tendencies§! modifier will rebel.

entries.zh: 轻信这些谈判是他们太愚蠢了。
entries.en: They're foolish to trust in these negotiations.

entries.zh: 所有有平等主义思潮的人都会被被杀死！\n$paragon.leader.delusion.negative$
entries.en: Every pop with an Egalitarian Ethic will be killed!\n$paragon.leader.delusion.negative$

entries.zh: 够了！我们的领袖让我们失望了！
entries.en: Enough! Our leader has failed us!

entries.zh: §Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!将被暗杀。\n§R国家将分裂并陷入内战。§!\n§L国家处于混乱之中。人们迫切地想点燃革命的火焰。我们已经听到了他们的号召。必须消灭所有暴政！§!
entries.en: §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! will be assassinated.\n§RThe nation will fracture and a civil war will begin.§!\n§LThe nation is in disarray. People are desperate to light the flame of revolution. We have heard their call. All tyrants must be deposed!§!

entries.zh: 我们应该统治星系，单独统治！
entries.en: We should rule the galaxy, alone!

entries.zh: 我们成功挣脱了锁链！所有压迫者和暴君都已被推翻。我们可能是引发这场战争的火花，但我们所做的一切都是为了人民的利益。我们必将战胜一切！
entries.en: Our chains are broken! All oppressors and tyrants have been cast down. We may have been the spark that lit this war, but everything we do is for the good of the people. We shall overcome!

entries.zh: 我们为了捍卫自己的道路而战！
entries.en: We fight to preserve our ways!

entries.zh: 我们为了探寻新的道路而战！
entries.en: We fight to change our ways!

entries.zh: 随着内乱的余烬逐渐地消失，一个新的社会正从灰烬中崛起，准备将革命的火花带到星空。
entries.en: As the embers of civil strife fade away, a new society is rising from the ashes, ready to carry the spark of revolution to the stars.

entries.zh: 我们要重建被摧毁的一切。
entries.en: We shall rebuild what was destroyed.

entries.zh: 我们必须保卫自己的社会！
entries.en: We need to safeguard our society!
The civil war has hardened us.

entries.zh: 我们必须优先发展和平与繁荣。
entries.en: We must prioritize peace and prosperity.

entries.zh: 自这样的灾难中，我们必会成长。
entries.en: From the devastation, we will grow.

entries.zh: 在谈判前夕，各方显然厌倦了战火，愿意促成协议。我们不知道这将产生什么样的长期后果，但现在我们团结起来了。
entries.en: On the eve of the negotiations, it became clear that the parties were sick of warring and would rather strike a deal. We cannot know what long-term consequences this will have, but for now we are united.

entries.zh: §L我们要么通过武力，要么通过谈判来解决分歧。从现在开始，我们要真正团结起来。§!
entries.en: §LWe settle our differences either through might or through negotiation. From now on, we are truly united.§!

entries.zh: 在谈判前夕，局势已经很明显，各方都无法达成一致。即使现在，叛乱实力也正在集结，战争爆发了。再一次我们的国家处于分裂的状态。
entries.en: On the eve of the negotiations, it became clear that the parties would never come to an agreement. Even now, rebel forces are massing, and war has been declared. Once more our nation stands divided.

entries.zh: 带有§Y民主倾向§!修正的行星将形成一个起义帝国的核心。
entries.en: Planets with the §YDemocratic Tendencies§! modifier will form the core of a rebel empire.

entries.zh: 号召谈判是一个捕获改革派领袖的完美陷阱。他们聚集在一个地方，收网有如探囊取物。我们不费吹灰之力就获得了有关他们藏身之处、下线和资产的信息。剩下的反对派也轻松地处理掉了，不需要任何让步，也没有发生代价高昂的内战。所有改革派都被§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的法令判处死刑。
entries.en: The call to negotiations was a perfect trap for the Reformist leaders. Gathered in one place, they were easily apprehended. We wasted no time extracting information about their hideouts, followers, and assets. The remaining opposition was swiftly dealt with, without concessions or a costly civil war. Every Reformist has been sentenced to death by decree of §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!.

entries.zh: 我们现在不能回头了。只能继续。
entries.en: We can't turn back now. Proceed.

entries.zh: 随着内乱的余烬逐渐地消失，一个新的社会正从灰烬中崛起，准备将§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的智慧火花带到星空。
entries.en: As the embers of civil strife fade away, a new society is rising from the ashes, ready to carry the spark of §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!'s wisdom to the stars.
One country, one Luminary, one future.

entries.zh: 在第一阶段完成后，涡旋状的灵能能量充满了行星，席卷了整个地表。虽然现在无法在那里生存，但最强的灵能使汇聚一堂，守护着举行下一阶段仪式的寺庙。现在，需要做的只剩下将这些灵能力量从我们志愿者身上传到入§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的体内。这样将会大幅度提升我们§Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§!的灵能能力。
entries.en: At the completion of the first phase, swirling psionic energies engulfed the planet and ravaged its surface. Although it is now impossible to survive there, our strongest psionics gathered to shield a temple at which the next phase of the ritual will take place. Now, all that remains is to direct the psionic force from our volunteers into §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!. Doing so should greatly bolster the psionic capabilities of our §Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§!.

entries.zh:
初始献祭：§R[ROOT.paragon_origin_ascension]公民§!
每十年献祭需要：§R[ROOT.paragon_origin_ascension]公民§!
所选灵能能力：§G[Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Focus][Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Trait1][Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Trait2][Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Trait3][Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Trait4]§!

我们最强大的灵能者正在驯服消耗整颗行星所产生的狂野能量。他们现在将这些力量汇聚到神殿中心，那里有等待的被献祭者。很快仪式就要开始了，这些勇敢志愿者的灵能能量将被提取并注入§Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§!体内。被献祭者越多，灵能能量就越强——但我们必须小心不要超过§Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§!的控制范围，否则可能会面临一场非常可观的灾难。

一但仪式结束，我们需要持续供应一系列志愿者，以避免§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!的身体被能量摧毁。
entries.en:
Initial sacrifice: §R[ROOT.paragon_origin_ascension] Citizens§!
Decennial sacrifices needed: §R[ROOT.paragon_origin_ascension] Citizens§!
Chosen psychic powers: §G[Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Focus] [Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Trait1] [Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Trait2] [Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Trait3] [Paragon_Origin_Ascension_Trait4]§!

Our strongest telepaths are taming the wild energies consuming the planet. They will now funnel these toward the center of the temple, where the sacrificial candidates stand waiting. Soon the ceremony will begin, and the psionic powers of these brave volunteers will be extracted and directed into the §Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§!. The more people consumed, the stronger the psionic energy - but we must be careful not to go beyond what the §Y[Ruler.GetTitle]'s§! can control, or we risk a spectacular catastrophe.

Once the ritual is complete, we will need to supply a steady stream of volunteers to prevent the power from destroying the §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]§! body.

entries.zh: §L§Y[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]§!可能会瞥见其他维度，甚至时间线，扩展[Ruler.GetHerHis]思想。§!\n\n获得随机§G统治者特质§!
